title: LatticeMind: A Validation-Gated Agentic Framework for Density Functional Theory Workflows
comment: 26 pages, 12 figures, and 12 tables, including Supplemental Material. Prepared for submission to PRX Intelligence
summary: First-principles calculations are rarely single solver calls: they are multistage workflows in which structures, settings, and saved densities must pass correctly between dependent stages. Language models can write a valid single input, but reliability collapses once stages are chained: a dropped dependency, wrong file handoff, or hallucinated keyword can invalidate results even when the solver runs, and such errors surface only after costly execution. We introduce LatticeMind, a validation-gated agentic framework that converts natural-language requests into executable, checkable density functional theory (DFT) projects. A workflow contract specifies required stages, files, and dependencies; deterministic validators inspect the project before any solver launch; failed checks trigger bounded repair; and reports remain traceable to project files. On a 44-case RESCU benchmark spanning total-energy, density-of-states, band-structure, magnetic, phonon workflows, three non-flagship LLM backends reproduced every reference value; 119 of 132 runs passed on the first validated plan and the rest after one repair cycle. Ablations identify the workflow contract and pre-execution validation as the principal reliability mechanisms; a conventional trial-and-repair baseline reaches 71% at twice the token cost per success. The same architecture reproduces every reference value on a 19-case VASP benchmark, demonstrating transfer across solvers. Beyond these task families, LatticeMind generated and validated the 23 inputs of a multistage study of Rh-induced electronic responses at a Rh$_6$/In$_x$Ga$_{1-x}$N photocatalyst interface. These results establish workflow contracts, deterministic validation, bounded repair, and traceable records as a practical foundation for reliable AI-assisted scientific computing, where preventable errors are caught before execution and the solver is never the first validator.

AI.tldr: LatticeMind 是一个"验证门控"的智能体框架，把自然语言请求转换为可执行、可检验的 DFT 多阶段工作流项目：先由工作流契约定义所需阶段、文件与依赖，再由确定性校验器在调用求解器前检查，失败时进行有界修复，并可追溯至项目文件。
AI.motivation: 第一性原理计算往往是多阶段工作流，而非单次求解器调用，阶段间需正确传递结构、设置与已保存的电荷密度。LLM 能写出合法的单个输入，但一旦把多个阶段串联，可靠性就会崩溃：依赖丢失、文件交接错误、幻觉关键词等错误即使求解器能运行也会使结果失效，且只有在昂贵执行之后才暴露。
AI.method: 1) 工作流契约（workflow contract）规定必需阶段、文件与依赖；2) 确定性校验器在启动任何求解器前检查项目；3) 校验失败触发有界（一次循环）修复；4) 报告可追溯至项目文件。在 44 例 RESCU 基准（总能量、态密度、能带、磁性、声子）与 19 例 VASP 基准上评测，使用三个非旗舰 LLM 后端，并做消融与基线对比（常规试错修复）。
AI.result: RESCU 上三个后端均复现全部参考值；132 次运行中 119 次首次验证计划即通过，其余经一次修复通过。消融表明工作流契约与执行前校验是主要可靠性机制；常规试错修复基线成功率 71%，成功所需 token 成本为两倍。VASP 19 例基准同样复现全部参考值，证明跨求解器可迁移。此外生成并验证了 Rh₆/InₓGa₁₋ₓN 光催化剂界面 Rh 诱导电子响应多阶段研究的 23 个输入。
AI.conclusion: 工作流契约、确定性校验、有界修复与可追溯记录，是可靠 AI 辅助科学计算的实用基础：可预防的错误在执行前被捕获，"求解器永远不是第一验证者"。

title: Vortex matter as a magnetically programmable metasurface for tuning near-field radiative heat transfer
summary: Near-field radiative heat transfer (NFRHT) is of great interest for energy conversion and thermal management. Recent work on NFRHT has shown that metasurfaces can enhance NFRHT and reshape its spectral characteristics. Here, we show that the vortex lattice of a type-II superconductor represents a self-assembled metasurface whose lattice dimensions, in contrast to most other metasurfaces, can be tuned by magnetic fields, allowing NFRHT to be varied by orders of magnitude. Specifically, we show that for two Nb surfaces at 4.2 K and separated by a 100 nm gap, NFRHT can be magnetically tuned by a factor >200. Further, we show that the tuning range grows upon cooling, exceeding 10^5 at 2 K, which is far beyond the order-unity modulation of many proposed schemes for tuning NFRHT. Our results establish vortex matter as a magnetically programmable thermal metasurface and open new opportunities for tuning the flow of heat at the nanoscale.

AI.tldr: II型超导体的涡旋点阵可作为一种自组装、磁可调的"热学超表面"，使近场辐射传热随磁场变化数个量级（4.2 K下>200倍，2 K下>10^5倍）。
AI.motivation: 近场辐射传热（NFRHT）在能量转换与热管理中有重要价值，已有研究表明超表面可增强并重塑其光谱特性；但多数超表面结构固定、调制幅度仅为量级一（order-unity），缺乏大范围可调手段。作者希望找到一种可通过外场（磁场）大幅调控的、自组装的超表面。
AI.method: 提出将II型超导体的涡旋点阵视为自组装超表面：其点阵尺寸由磁场直接调控。以两块4.2 K的Nb表面、间距100 nm的构型为对象，计算/分析不同磁场下涡旋点阵对NFRHT的影响，并考察降温至2 K时的调控范围。
AI.result: 在4.2 K、100 nm间隙下，NFRHT可被磁场调控超过200倍；降温至2 K时调控范围进一步扩大至超过10^5倍，远超已有的量级一调制方案。
AI.conclusion: 涡旋物质可被视为一种"磁可编程热学超表面"，为纳米尺度热流调控开辟了新途径。

title: High-Field and Light-Dependent Magnetization Provides Evidence for Coexisting Granular Superconductivity and Superparamagnetism in Nitrogen-Doped Diamond
summary: We investigated the field-, temperature-, and time-dependent magnetic moment of a nitrogen-doped type Ib diamond in darkness and under monochromatic light with a low laser intensity of about 160 $μ$W cm$^{-2}$. In darkness, below approximately 25 K, the magnetic moment exhibits unconventional hysteresis loops that can be explained by the coexistence of superparamagnetism and superconductivity in certain regions of the sample. Under illumination, this hysteresis largely disappears, leaving mainly the superparamagnetic contribution. Temperature-dependent measurements reveal an irreversibility below 25 K in darkness, which vanishes under illumination. Similarly, at 0.5 T and below 25 K, the time-dependent magnetization shows flux-creep-like behavior that disappears when the sample is illuminated. All light-induced changes are fully reversible: the magnetic properties measured in darkness are restored after the sample is heated above roughly 50 K. Removing the superparamagnetic contribution from magnetization measurements up to $\pm 14$ T reveals clear characteristics of a granular superconductor, namely, a well-defined penetration field $H_p \approx 2.6$ T and a critical field $H_{c2} \approx 10.6$ T. Based on theoretical considerations, we attribute the observed phenomena to the combined effects of internal stress and local variations in nitrogen concentration within localized regions that can be regarded as grains. This interpretation is supported by Raman and birefringence spectroscopy measurements on the same sample.

AI.tldr: 该研究报道了低强度光照可逆地抑制氮掺杂Ib型金刚石在25 K以下的超导相关磁信号（磁滞、不可逆性、磁通蠕变），揭示其颗粒超导特征，并归因于内应力与局域氮浓度起伏。
AI.motivation: 探究氮掺杂金刚石中可能存在的超导性及其磁学表现，并理解光照、温度和局域结构不均匀性对该磁性的调控作用。
AI.method: 测量氮掺杂Ib型金刚石在暗态与约160 μW cm⁻²单色光下的场、温、时间依赖磁矩；去除超顺磁贡献后分析超导特征；结合Raman与双折射光谱表征同一样品。
AI.result: 暗态下约25 K以下出现非常规磁滞回线（超顺磁+超导共存）、不可逆性及类磁通蠕变行为，光照后基本消失；加热至约50 K以上可完全恢复。去除超顺磁贡献后得到颗粒超导体特征：穿透场Hp≈2.6 T、上临界场Hc2≈10.6 T。Raman与双折射结果支持内应力与局域氮浓度不均（颗粒区域）的解释。
AI.conclusion: 氮掺杂Ib金刚石中局域区域表现出颗粒超导性，其磁信号可被低强度光照可逆抑制，机制归于内应力与氮浓度局域涨落的共同作用。

title: Zeeman Quantum Geometry of the Layer Pseudo-spin
summary: Two-dimensional layers coupled by position-dependent interlayer tunnelling host a layer pseudo-spin whose polarization is a controllable internal degree of freedom. We introduce the quantum geometry of this layer pseudo-spin: a mixed tensor formed from the interband Berry connection and the layer matrix element, which governs the response to an oscillating in-plane electric field. Because the layer pseudo-spin is an Ising-type scalar invariant under threefold rotation, its selection rules differ from those of a pseudovector spin. In a minimal two-band model, the layer-pseudo-spin quantum metric and Zeeman--Berry curvature are nonzero, while their zone integrals vanish. An in-plane drive therefore leaves the spatially averaged polarization unchanged at linear order but imprints a moiré-periodic intracell pattern, directly imageable by layer-resolved tunnelling. For twisted MoTe$_2$ bilayer, we quantify the local dipole modulation and identify the rectified, helicity-odd, and third-harmonic channels through which a net response appears at higher order.

AI.tldr: 论文引入"层赝自旋量子几何"，用一个混合张量（层间Berry联络×层矩阵元）刻画双层莫尔体系对振荡面内电场的响应，并分析其选择定则与扭角MoTe₂中的局域偶极调制。
AI.motivation: 由位置依赖层间隧穿耦合的二维层具有可调控的层赝自旋极化作为内禀自由度，但缺乏描述其量子几何与电场响应的理论框架。
AI.method: 构造层赝自旋量子几何：由层间Berry联络与层矩阵元组成的混合张量。由于层赝自旋为三重旋转下不变的Ising型标量，其选择定则不同于赝矢量自旋。在最小两能带模型中计算层赝自旋量子度规与Zeeman–Berry曲率，并应用于扭角MoTe₂双层。
AI.result: 最小模型中量子度规与Zeeman–Berry曲率非零但布里渊区积分消失；面内驱动在线性阶不改变空间平均极化，却写入莫尔周期的胞内图样，可由层分辨隧穿直接成像。对扭角MoTe₂定量给出局域偶极调制，并识别整流、螺旋度奇和三次谐波等高阶净响应通道。
AI.conclusion: 层赝自旋量子几何为层-电场耦合提供了新描述，预测可成像的莫尔周期胞内极化图样及高阶光学响应通道，适用于扭角MoTe₂等莫尔体系。

title: Tailoring Dielectric Relaxation and Charge Transport in Amorphous Ge-Te-Se Phase-Change Materials through Yttrium Incorporation
summary: The Te(1-x)(GeSe0.5)Yx (x = 0.05, 0.10, 0.15) alloys were prepared by a melt-quenching method and characterized using dielectric spectroscopy. The dielectric parameters and electrical conductivity were evaluated to assess their potential for phase-change memory and other electronic applications. The temperature and frequency dependence of the dielectric constants, ac conductivity, and dielectric loss of prepared chalcogenide glassy alloys were investigated over the frequency range 1 Hz - 1 MHz, and the temperature range 302 - 422 K, below the glass transition temperature. Both dielectric loss and dielectric constant were found to decrease with increasing frequency and decreasing temperature. The observed dielectric loss change was interpreted using the Guintini model of dielectric dispersion, correlated barrier hopping (CBH) model, and orientation polarization. The Cole-Cole analysis confirmed a distribution of relaxation times and yielded activation energies consistent with the CBH conduction mechanism. The frequency dependence of the ac conductivity follows the power law (Aωs), where the frequency exponent (s < 1) decreases with increasing temperature, further supporting the CBH conduction mechanism. The incorporation of Y increases the density of localized tail states, resulting in enhanced ac conductivity. These findings suggest that the investigated materials are promising candidates for future phase-change memory and other electronic device applications.

AI.tldr: 研究了Te(1-x)(GeSe0.5)Yx (x=0.05,0.10,0.15)硫系玻璃的介电与交流电导特性，确认其传导符合相关势垒跳跃(CBH)机制，Y掺杂提升局域态密度从而增强电导，材料有望用于相变存储等电子器件。
AI.motivation: 评估Te-GeSe-Y硫系玻璃合金在相变存储及其他电子应用中的潜力，需系统了解其介电弛豫与交流导电行为及Y掺入的影响。
AI.method: 熔淬法制备Te(1-x)(GeSe0.5)Yx合金，用介电谱在1 Hz–1 MHz、302–422 K（低于玻璃化转变温度）范围测量介电常数、介电损耗和交流电导；用Guintini介电色散模型、CBH模型和取向极化解释损耗，并用Cole-Cole分析弛豫时间分布与活化能。
AI.result: 介电常数与介电损耗随频率升高和温度降低而减小；Cole-Cole分析显示存在弛豫时间分布，所得活化能与CBH导电机制一致；交流电导遵循Aω^s幂律，指数s<1且随温度升高而减小，进一步支持CBH机制；Y掺入增加局域尾态密度，使交流电导增强。
AI.conclusion: 该体系导电由CBH机制主导，Y掺杂可调控局域态密度与电导，材料是相变存储及其他电子器件的有前景候选者。

title: Heat-current-induced nonreciprocal phonon damping
summary: Time-reversal symmetry enforces equal equilibrium linewidths for time-reversed phonon modes at opposite wave vectors. Here we show that a steady heat current can produce nonreciprocal anharmonic damping even in centrosymmetric nonmagnetic crystals. The effect arises from nonequilibrium occupations of scattering partners, which change the statistical weights of time-reversed three-phonon channels while their squared matrix elements remain equal. Within the single-mode relaxation-time approximation, we derive a linewidth correction that is linear in the temperature gradient and odd under wave-vector reversal. The response depends on scattering-partner velocities and equilibrium lifetimes and retains signed channel weights absent from the equilibrium linewidth. First-principles calculations for centrosymmetric MgO and diamond yield nonzero, mode-dependent linewidth corrections at selected finite wave vectors, demonstrating the mechanism in both ionic and covalent crystals. Reversing the heat current at fixed local temperature exchanges the broadening and narrowing of paired modes. This current-reversible linewidth contrast provides a spectral signature of occupation feedback, with potential implications for nonlinear phonon transport.

AI.tldr: 本文指出稳态热流可在中心对称非磁性晶体中产生非互易的非谐阻尼，源于散射伙伴的非平衡占据改变了时间反演三声子通道的统计权重，并推导出线性于温度梯度、在波矢反演下为奇函数的线宽修正，在MgO与金刚石的第一性原理计算中得到验证。
AI.motivation: 时间反演对称性要求相反波矢处时间反演声子模的平衡线宽相等，因此人们通常认为线宽互易；作者希望探究在非平衡热流条件下，这种对称性约束是否会被打破、从而出现非互易的声子阻尼。
AI.method: 在单模弛豫时间近似下，考虑散射伙伴的非平衡占据对时间反演三声子散射通道统计权重的影响（尽管其矩阵元平方仍相等），推导出对温度梯度线性、在波矢反演下为奇的线宽修正；并对中心对称的离子晶体MgO与共价晶体金刚石进行第一性原理计算。
AI.result: 在MgO和金刚石中，于选定有限波矢处得到非零且依赖模式的线宽修正，证明该机制在离子与共价晶体中均成立。修正在固定局域温度下反转热流方向时，会交换成对模式的展宽与变窄；响应依赖散射伙伴速度与平衡寿命，并保留平衡线宽中不存在的带符号通道权重。
AI.conclusion: 热流驱动的占据反馈可导致可逆的线宽对比，这为占据反馈提供了光谱特征，并对非线性声子输运具有潜在意义。

title: MOFFieldBench: A Machine Learning Benchmark for Continuous Electronic Fields in Metal-Organic Frameworks
summary: Machine-learning models for metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) predominantly rely on atomic structures, whereas electron-density (ED) and electrostatic-potential (ESP) fields remain underexplored as scalable learning representations. These continuous fields encode complementary spatial and electronic information relevant to structure-property relationships, particularly pore geometry and guest-framework interactions, but costly first-principles calculations, storage requirements and the scarcity of systematically aligned datasets limit their broader use. Here we introduce MOFFieldBench, a multimodal benchmark comprising approximately 46,000 MOFs with one-to-one aligned crystallographic structures, ED fields and ESP fields. A unified workflow integrates field generation, error-controlled compression and sparse point-cloud representation, supporting field reconstruction, prediction of 13 material properties, multimodal property prediction and pairwise cross-modal retrieval. ED and ESP provide competitive representations for pore geometry, adsorption and separation properties. Multimodal fusion improves several prediction tasks relative to the best unimodal reference, supporting complementary predictive roles for atomic structures and electronic fields. Learned ED reconstruction closely approximates first-principles reference densities, while predicted-density initialization reduces self-consistent-field calculation time by 13.59\% on average in paired tests. These results support electronic fields as practical, informative learning modalities and establish MOFFieldBench as a resource for studying representation choice, multimodal learning and electronic-field-driven MOF modelling.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MOFFieldBench——约4.6万MOF的多模态基准，对齐晶体结构、电子密度(ED)与静电势(ESP)场，并验证电子场作为可扩展学习表征的价值。
AI.motivation: 现有MOF机器学习模型多依赖原子结构，ED/ESP等连续场虽蕴含孔隙几何与主客体相互作用的互补信息，但受限于昂贵的第一性原理计算、存储开销及缺乏系统对齐数据集而未被充分利用。
AI.method: 构建包含约46,000个MOF的数据集，每个样本一对一地对齐晶体结构、ED场和ESP场；设计统一流程整合场生成、误差可控压缩与稀疏点云表示；支持场重建、13种性质预测、多模态性质预测及跨模态检索等任务。
AI.result: ED与ESP在孔隙几何、吸附与分离性质上提供有竞争力的表征；多模态融合相较最佳单模态基线提升若干预测任务；学习到的ED重建接近第一性原理参考密度，且用预测密度初始化平均可减少13.59%的SCF计算时间。
AI.conclusion: 电子场是实用且信息丰富的学习模态，MOFFieldBench可作为研究表征选择、多模态学习及电子场驱动MOF建模的资源平台。

title: Field Theory of the Gutzwiller Projection
summary: The Gutzwiller projection produces a well-known ansatz for spin-liquid and quantum Hall ground-state wavefunctions that is amenable to numerical simulation, with the Laughlin wavefunction being the most celebrated example. A long-standing issue is the precise relation between the Gutzwiller projection and the closely related parton gauge theory. Here, we clarify this issue by providing a field-theoretic description of the Gutzwiller projection. In a path integral description, the universal physics of the projected state is described in terms of a gauge field supported on a temporal slab of vanishing width $ε\rightarrow 0$ coupled to the bulk matter fields. We analytically derive the universal physics of various Gutzwiller projected states. Our construction is also applicable to discrete symmetries, and we use it to analyze various projected SPT states. Among our results, we show that the Gutzwiller projection is not a good ansatz for the long-distance properties of $U(1)$ Dirac spin liquids, spinon Fermi surface spin liquids or composite Fermi liquids, and that the Gutzwiller projection of a quantum spin Hall state has only quasi-long range order. In contrast, in examples where the gauge field is gapped, including Laughlin states, $\mathbb{Z}_2$ spin liquids and Luttinger liquids, we show that the slab gauge theory from Gutzwiller projection reproduces the correct universal physics of the full parton gauge theory. We also present a generalization of our field theory that describes $G$-intertwining defects, with application to self-duality defects of recent theoretical interest.

AI.tldr: 本文用场论方法刻画Gutzwiller投影，指出投影态普遍物理可用一道位于零宽度时间薄片上的规范场耦合体态物质场来描述，并借此判定投影是否为正确的普适物理描述。
AI.motivation: Gutzwiller投影（如Laughlin波函数）是数值友好的自旋液体/量子霍尔试探波函数，但它与parton规范理论之间精确关系长期不清，需要澄清投影态是否保留parton理论的普适物理。
AI.method: 在路径积分框架下，将Gutzwiller投影表示为局域于宽度ε→0时间薄片上的规范场与体态物质场耦合的“slab规范理论”，并解析推导各类投影态的普适行为；方法可推广至离散对称性，用于分析投影SPT态。
AI.result: Gutzwiller投影对U(1)狄拉克自旋液体、自旋子费米面自旋液体和复合费米液体的长程性质并非好拟设；量子自旋霍尔态投影后只有准长程序。反之，规范场有能隙时——如Laughlin态、Z2自旋液体和Luttinger液体——slab规范理论复现了完整parton规范理论的正确普适物理。
AI.conclusion: 投影的有效性取决于规范场是否有能隙：无能隙时投影破坏普适物理，有能隙时投影等价于parton理论。文章还推广到场论描述G-缠绕缺陷，并应用于自对偶缺陷。

title: Spectral signatures of hidden order and hidden quantum critical points
summary: Hidden-order phases elude the conventional Ginzburg-Landau framework: although they spontaneously break symmetry, their order remains invisible to standard local two-point correlators. Instead, they are typically characterized by nonlocal (string) order parameters and are believed to underlie a range of exotic quantum states, such as symmetry-protected topological (SPT) phases. While hidden correlations have previously been detected through nonlocal observables in quantum gas microscope experiments, in realistic solid-state systems multipoint observables are typically inaccessible and the signatures of hidden order remain largely unexplored. In this work, we show that hidden order in doped spin chains can be directly probed through dynamical two-point response functions measurable by resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS) and neutron scattering. Focusing on a minimal model, we numerically identify clear spectral fingerprints of both the hidden-order phase, its associated hidden quantum critical point as well as a specific group of gapless SPT phases. Complementing our numerical results with analytical insights, we uncover the microscopic origin of these spectral signatures and demonstrate how they emerge from the interplay between spin and charge degrees of freedom. Together, our results establish spectroscopy as a practical probe of hidden order and gapless SPT phases and provide a unified understanding of the low-energy physics governing these unconventional quantum phases.

AI.tldr: 该文提出用动力学两点响应函数（可由RIXS和中子散射测量）直接探测掺杂自旋链中的隐藏序，并数值识别出隐藏序相、隐藏量子临界点及一类无能隙SPT相的谱学指纹。
AI.motivation: 隐藏序相虽自发破缺对称性，但对常规局域两点关联函数"不可见"，通常需非局域弦序参量刻画；而实际固体系统中多点非局域观测量难以获取，隐藏序的可测信号长期缺乏研究。
AI.method: 聚焦一个最小模型，对掺杂自旋链进行数值计算（如精确对角化/DMRG等），获得动力学两点响应函数谱，并结合解析分析揭示自旋与电荷自由度相互作用产生谱学特征的微观机制。
AI.result: 数值上清晰识别出隐藏序相、隐藏量子临界点以及一组无能隙SPT相的谱学指纹；解析分析阐明了这些指纹的微观起源。
AI.conclusion: 谱学（RIXS、中子散射）可作为探测隐藏序与无能隙SPT相的实用手段，并统一了对这些非常规量子相低能物理的理解。

title: Stacking-Induced Tuning of a Flat-Band Surface State in NbIrTe4
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to Phys. Rev. B
summary: Ternary layered transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) offer high tunability and access to correlated and topological states. However, like the broader family of layered TMDCs, their properties are sensitive to stacking order and interlayer coupling. Here, we investigate the electronic structure and surface states of NbIrTe$_4$, a candidate Weyl semimetal in bulk, and predicted to be a quantum spin Hall insulator in monolayer form. Using scanning tunnelling microscopy (STM), angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES), and density-functional theory (DFT), we attribute the strong resonance in tunnelling spectroscopy located approximately 8 meV below the Fermi level to a surface-derived flat band which shows sensitivity to the local stacking order at the surface. In regions where the top layer is laterally shifted, tunnelling spectroscopy instead shows a gap-like feature with intensity near the Fermi level shifted in energy. Combining DFT and quasiparticle interference (QPI) measurements, we find this dramatic change in the spectroscopy in the vicinity of the quasi-1D flat-band surface state becomes dispersive due to a change in the spatial distribution of the density of states in the top two layers. These findings establish NbIrTe$_4$ as a platform where surface band dispersion can be effectively tuned through local structural manipulation.

AI.tldr: 该文结合STM、ARPES与DFT研究三元TMDC NbIrTe₄，发现费米能级下约8 meV存在表面起源的平带，其对表层堆叠序敏感；在顶层横向位移区域谱学特征剧烈改变，准一维平带表面态因顶层两层DOS空间分布变化而变得色散，表明NbIrTe₄可通过局域结构调控表面能带色散。
AI.motivation: 三元层状TMDC具有高可调性并可能承载关联与拓扑态，但其电子性质对堆叠序和层间耦合高度敏感。NbIrTe₄体态为候选Weyl半金属、单层预测为量子自旋霍尔绝缘体，亟需厘清其电子结构与表面态，并理解堆叠序如何影响表面能带。
AI.method: 采用扫描隧道显微镜/谱（STM/STS）、角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）与密度泛函理论（DFT）相结合；并将DFT与准粒子干涉（QPI）测量结合，分析表面态的空间DOS分布与色散。
AI.result: 在费米能级下约8 meV观测到强共振，归因于表面起源的平带，且对表面局域堆叠序敏感；顶层横向位移区域出现类能隙特征、费米能级附近强度发生能量移动；在准一维平带表面态附近，因顶部两层DOS空间分布改变，谱学响应变为色散性。
AI.conclusion: NbIrTe₄是一个可通过局域结构操控有效调节表面能带色散的平台，凸显堆叠序与层间耦合对三元TMDC表面电子态的关键作用。

title: An efficient approach to electron-phonon coupling calculations of heterostructures within an all-electron framework
summary: A major challenge in calculating electron-phonon coupling at interfaces from first principles is the prohibitive computational cost due to the large supercells involved. Here, we present an efficient approach, which builds the electron-phonon matrix of weakly bound heterostructures from the properties of the isolated layers. The two key ingredients, the dynamical matrices and the potential response, are constructed in two steps. In the expansion step, these quantities are folded from the unit cells onto the supercell through an exact Fourier mapping. In the addition step, the interatomic force constants and the potential responses of the heterostructure are assembled blockwise from the corresponding quantities of the isolated layers, neglecting the weak interlayer contribution. The method is implemented in the electron-phonon module of the all-electron full-potential code exciting, enabling efficient calculations of the electron-phonon self-energy. We demonstrate the approach for the phonon dispersion and spectral functions of bilayer WSe$_2$ and pyridine/MoS$_2$, in comparison with exact reference calculations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种从孤立层性质构建弱束缚异质结构电子-声子矩阵的高效方法，避免大超胞计算，在exciting软件中实现并验证。
AI.motivation: 从第一性原理计算界面电子-声子耦合时，大超胞导致计算成本过高，难以承受。
AI.method: 基于孤立层性质构建异质结构的电子-声子矩阵，分两步：扩展步骤通过精确傅里叶映射将动力学矩阵和势响应从单胞折叠到超胞；叠加步骤按块从孤立层量组装异质结构的原子间力常数和势响应，忽略弱的层间贡献。方法实现于全电子全势代码exciting的电子-声子模块中。
AI.result: 在双层WSe₂和吡啶/MoS₂上演示声子色散与谱函数计算，并与精确参考计算进行对比验证。
AI.conclusion: 该近似方法能高效计算异质结构的电子-声子自能，结果与精确参考计算吻合。

title: Quantum Oscillations across Hole Crystallization in Rhombohedral Graphene
summary: Recent quantum-oscillation measurements in rhombohedral graphene reveal an abrupt increase in the dominant frequency and the emergence of additional frequencies as the carrier density is lowered toward superconductivity. Noninteracting band models can account for multiple frequencies but do not explain the upward jump. We show that these features can arise from two competing fates of the inner hole pocket in an annular Fermi sea: collapse into a simply connected Fermi liquid or crystallization into an anticrystal, in which localized holes coexist with itinerant electrons. Pocket collapse contracts the outer Fermi contour at fixed density, whereas hole crystallization preserves a larger contour that supports magnetic-breakdown orbits. This contrast provides a possible explanation for the frequency jump, while additional reconstructed orbits produce a multitone spectrum. Our results support the anticrystal as a candidate normal state near superconductivity in rhombohedral graphene.

AI.tldr: 在菱形石墨烯中,靠近超导相的低载流子密度下,量子振荡主频突增并出现额外频率;作者用内空穴口袋"坍缩"或"结晶为反晶体"两种竞争命运解释这一现象。
AI.motivation: 近期菱形石墨烯量子振荡实验发现随载流子密度降低至超导区,主频突增并出现额外频率。非相互作用能带模型可解释多频,却无法解释频率上跳,作者希望给出该反常的解释。
AI.method: 基于环形费米海的内空穴口袋,提出两种竞争图景:(1)坍缩为简单连通的费米液体;(2)结晶为"反晶体",即局域空穴与巡游电子共存。比较两者对外费米轮廓及磁击穿轨道的影响。
AI.result: 口袋坍缩在固定密度下缩小外费米轮廓;空穴结晶则保留较大轮廓并支持磁击穿轨道,二者对比可解释频率上跳,而额外重构轨道产生多音频谱。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持"反晶体"作为菱形石墨烯中超导附近的候选正常态。

title: Ballistic transport and crystallographic control in altermagnetic quantum rings
summary: We study coherent two-terminal transport through a finite-width $d$-wave altermagnetic quantum ring with nonmagnetic leads. A confined Aharonov--Bohm flux remains exactly $h/e$ periodic and, in the symmetric one-mode geometry, produces an exact half-flux transmission zero. A perpendicular field shifts the interference pattern according to an effective area $A_{\rm eff}=1.0342\,πr_0^2$ and the altermagnetic splitting resolves the common zero into nearby spin-dependent nodes. Rotating the crystal reverses the transmitted spin, whereas the mirror orientation $θ_A=π/4$ is exactly spin degenerate. For a $50$~nm reference ring, sub-tesla fields yield windows with $|P_T|>0.99$, the most accessible of which requires a uniform field alone and no confined flux. Finite-bias, thermal, disorder, Zeeman, and spin-conserving voltage-probe calculations show that the polarization is appreciably more stable than individual coherent-resonance amplitudes. These results identify interference-node positions, flux periodicity, and crystal-controlled spin polarization as experimentally useful signatures of an altermagnetic mesoscopic interferometer.

AI.tldr: 研究有限宽 d 波交错磁（altermagnetic）量子环的双端相干输运，指出 AB 通量严格 h/e 周期、对称单模几何下存在精确半通量透射零点，且晶体转动可翻转透射自旋，镜面取向 θ_A=π/4 时完全自旋简并。
AI.motivation: 探索交错磁体在介观干涉器件中的自旋输运特征，寻找可实验识别的自旋极化与干涉节点信号。
AI.method: 有限宽 d 波交错磁量子环 + 非磁电极的相干输运计算；分析 AB 通量周期性与半通量零点、垂直磁场导致的有效面积 A_eff=1.0342πr_0² 的图样移动、交错磁劈裂使零点分裂为自旋相关节点；并做有限偏压、温度、无序、Zeeman 与自旋守恒电压探针计算。
AI.result: 对 50 nm 参考环，亚特斯拉磁场即可给出 |P_T|>0.99 的窗口，其中最易实现者仅需均匀磁场、无需约束通量；极化比单个相干共振幅度更稳定。
AI.conclusion: 干涉节点位置、通量周期性与晶体控制的自旋极化可作为交错磁介观干涉器的实验判据。

title: Diffusive Description of Superconducting Single-Photon Detectors Using Quantum Mechanics
summary: The methodology of non-Hermitian quantum mechanics is employed to parameterize the dynamics of coupled classical diffusion equations describing low- and high-energy quasiparticles in superconducting single-photon detectors in one to three spatial dimensions.

AI.tldr: 利用非厄米量子力学方法参数化描述超导单光子探测器中低能和高能准粒子耦合经典扩散方程的动力学，涵盖一至三维空间。
AI.motivation: 超导单光子探测器中低能和高能准粒子的动力学由耦合扩散方程描述，缺乏简洁统一的参数化框架，因此引入非厄米量子力学方法来刻画其动力学。
AI.method: 采用非厄米量子力学的方法论，对描述低能和高能准粒子的耦合经典扩散方程进行参数化，并在一至三维空间中建立对应模型。
AI.result: 给出了低能和高能准粒子耦合扩散方程的非厄米量子力学参数化表述，可适用于一至三维空间。
AI.conclusion: 非厄米量子力学为超导单光子探测器中准粒子扩散动力学提供了有效的统一参数化描述框架。

title: Nanoscale chemical engineering of Ti3C2Tx MXene multilayers through in situ electron beam irradiation in a TEM
summary: Defect engineering in low-dimensional materials is a powerful approach to tailor their structure and chemistry at the atomic scale, with high relevance for tuning physical properties. Here, we apply this strategy to MXenes, one of the largest families of two-dimensional (2D) materials, and demonstrate the use of a highly focused scanning transmission electron microscope (STEM) beam for the structural and chemical nanoengineering of titanium carbide (Ti3C2Tx) multilayers. By adjusting the beam energy, electron dose, and scanning parameters, Ti3C2Tx multilayers were irradiated at 80 and 300 keV and characterized in situ using annular dark-field imaging and electron energy-loss spectroscopy (EELS). The irradiation induces gradual structural and chemical modifications, largely driven by the selective sputtering of atomic species and MXene layers. We identify irradiation conditions that selectively remove Cl or F surface terminations while largely preserving the Ti3C2 framework, whereas other conditions promote preferential carbon removal, in agreement with theoretical predictions. Most notably, electron irradiation drives the migration and accumulation of initially dilute nitrogen impurities within the irradiated regions, leading to the formation of nitrogen-rich titanium carbonitride (Ti3CyNzTx) nanodomains embedded in the Ti3C2Tx multilayers. These laterally patterned carbide/carbonitride architectures constitute in-plane MXene heterostructures with nanometer-scale spatial control. These results demonstrate that electron irradiation can be used to locally tailor MXene composition and create nanoscale architectures beyond those accessible through conventional chemical synthesis.

AI.tldr: 利用聚焦STEM电子束对Ti3C2Tx MXene多层膜进行原位辐照，实现表面端基与碳的选择性溅射及氮杂质富集，构筑纳米尺度面内MXene异质结构。
AI.motivation: 低维材料的缺陷工程可在原子尺度调控结构与化学性质，但MXene这类二维材料缺乏在纳米尺度上局部、可控地裁剪成分与结构的手段，常规化学合成难以实现面内图案化架构。
AI.method: 在80和300 keV下用高度聚焦的STEM电子束辐照Ti3C2Tx多层膜，通过调节束能、电子剂量和扫描参数，结合环形暗场成像与原位EELS表征，并辅以理论预测对比。
AI.result: 辐照引起渐进的結構与化学改性，主要由原子种类和MXene层的选择性溅射驱动；找到可选择性去除Cl或F端基而基本保留Ti3C2骨架的条件，另有条件优先去除碳，与理论预测一致；最显著的是电子辐照驱动稀释氮杂质迁移富集，形成嵌入基体的富氮钛碳氮化物(Ti3CyNzTx)纳米畴。
AI.conclusion: 电子辐照可局部调控MXene成分并构建纳米尺度面内碳化物/碳氮化物异质结构，突破了常规化学合成的可及范围，为MXene纳米图案化与性能调控提供新途径。

title: Reaction-induced Localized Annealing for On-chip Materials Discovery
summary: On-chip thermal processing is a key technology for materials discovery across all disciplines of the natural sciences. Here, we present a microfabricated heat-delivery platform that enables reaction-induced localized on-chip annealing up to 1400°C. A buried reactive multilayer combined with a nanometric diffusion barrier provide ultra-fast heating and quenching rates on the order of 10$^6$°C s$^{-1}$ as illustrated by the generation of ultra-high aspect ratio microstructures during rapid-solidification and the stabilization of dopant-free tetragonal zirconia at room temperature. Rapid kinetics also enable the observation of transient states of capillary-driven hole collapse in melts. Our work expands localized high-temperature processing routes and offers a material-independent approach for rapid screening of multidimensional nanomaterials on and off-equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 提出一种微纳加工的片上热递送平台，借助埋入式反应多层膜与纳米扩散阻挡层，实现高达1400°C、升降温速率约10^6°C/s 的局域退火，用于快速筛选多维纳米材料并研究非平衡态。
AI.motivation: 片上热加工是材料发现的关键技术，但现有方法难以同时实现局域化、超高温与超快升降温，从而限制了非平衡/亚稳态材料的合成与瞬态过程观测。
AI.method: 设计微加工热递送平台：用埋入式反应多层膜作为反应诱导局域热源，配合纳米级扩散阻挡层，实现超快加热与淬火；并用快速凝固、室温稳定四方氧化锆及熔体中毛细驱动孔洞塌缩等实验验证。
AI.result: 实现最高约1400°C的局域退火与~10^6°C/s 的升降温速率；快速凝固得到超高长径比微结构，室温稳定无掺杂四方氧化锆，并观测到熔体中孔洞塌缩的瞬态状态。
AI.conclusion: 该平台拓展了局域高温处理路径，提供材料无关的方法，可在平衡与非平衡条件下快速筛选多维纳米材料，适用于片上及离片场景。

title: Fully Automated Wannier Disentanglement via Projectability Selection in Gaussian and Augmented Plane-Wave Frameworks
summary: Constructing the frozen manifold for entangled bands requires balancing exact reproduction of the target bands with sufficient variational freedom to build a well-localized subspace from the broader Bloch pool. We present a workflow that systematically determines the energy ceiling for a target number of selected Wannier projections, freezing every Bloch state below this threshold across the sampled k-mesh. By measuring projectability, the spectral weight of each Bloch state projected onto the target localized basis, the workflow detects missing conduction channels and quantifies discrepancies between orbital character and energy-based freezing. In comparisons where we controlled the extent of the energy ceiling, freezing all sub-ceiling states is generally favored over projectability-based frozen states. Of the seven materials we tested, freezing all sub-ceiling states lowers the band error on four from between 11 meV and 1.2 eV to 18 meV or less, and matches the projectability-based choice to within about 2 meV on the remaining three. In each of the four, projectability-based frozen states give the lower spread, showing that spread alone cannot identify the better model. With the frozen states held fixed, the workflow minimizes the gauge-invariant spread, constructs the gauge from density-matrix columns on atomic orbitals, and passes an isolated set of bands to Wannier90 for localization. The workflow is implemented in two programs for seamless high-throughput Wannierization with WIEN2k (wien2wannier) and CRYSTAL (LCAO2Wannier). Using a single set of calibrated defaults, the CRYSTAL implementation with analytic overlaps produces models that reproduce the reference bands of five cells, from bulk h-BN in a joint valence-and-conduction model to a magnetic framework with 1424 orbitals. The WIEN2k implementation produces eight such models from seven calculations.

AI.tldr: 提出自动化Wannierization工作流：通过系统性确定能量上限冻结子阈值Bloch态并测量projectability，可在WIEN2k与CRYSTAL上建立高精度局域化Wannier模型。
AI.motivation: 纠缠能带构造冻结流形时，需在精确复现目标能带与保持足够变分自由度以获得良好局域化子空间之间取得平衡；现有基于projectability的选择方法可能遗漏导电通道或与能量判据不一致。
AI.method: 工作流为目标数量的Wannier投影系统确定能量上限，冻结采样k网格上所有低于阈值的Bloch态；用projectability（Bloch态在目标局域基上的谱权重）检测缺失导电通道并量化轨道特征与能量冻结的偏差；固定冻结态后最小化规范不变展宽，由原子轨道密度矩阵列构造规范，将孤立能带组传给Wannier90做局域化；实现为wien2wannier与LCAO2Wannier。
AI.result: 7种材料中，冻结全部子阈值态使4种能带误差从11 meV–1.2 eV降至≤18 meV，其余3种与projectability选择相差约2 meV以内；但该4种中projectability冻结态展宽更小，说明展宽单独无法判别优劣。CRYSTAL实现用单组标定默认参数复现5个体系参考能带（h-BN价带+导带联合模型至1424轨道磁性框架）；WIEN2k实现从7个计算生成8个模型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作流建立了以projectability诊断与能量上限搜索互补的高通量Wannierization流程，无需逐体系调参即可生成忠实且局域化的Wannier模型，适用于多类材料与两种第一性原理代码。

title: Learning the Geometry of Materials Space with Trained Neural Tangent Kernels
summary: Neural networks trained to predict materials properties learn representations whose physical content can be difficult to extract. We use the neural tangent kernel (NTK), evaluated at trained parameters, to recover the geometry learned by a network that predicts superconducting transition temperatures from elemental composition alone. Kernel ridge regression with the trained NTK closely reproduces the network's predictive performance and substantially outperforms regression with the initial kernel. Spectral analysis and multidimensional scaling reveal a geometry dominated by a small number of directions. Clustering and local neighborhood analysis organize compounds into recognizable superconducting families and connect materials with related chemical and correlated-electron properties despite substantial differences in $T_c$. These results establish trained tangent kernels as practical probes of learned materials representations, connecting property prediction with the exploration of materials space.

AI.tldr: 本文用训练后的神经正切核(NTK)作为探针，解读预测超导转变温度的网络所学到的表示几何，发现该几何由少数方向主导，并能把化合物组织成可识别的超导家族。
AI.motivation: 神经网络预测材料性质时学到的表示其物理含义难以提取；作者希望找到一种实用工具来揭示网络内部学到的几何结构与物理内容。
AI.method: 对仅以元素组成为输入、预测超导Tc的网络，在训练参数处计算NTK；用该核做核岭回归并与初始核对比；再通过谱分析和多维尺度变换揭示几何结构，结合聚类与局部邻域分析考察化合物的组织方式。
AI.result: 训练后NTK的核岭回归几乎复现网络预测性能，且显著优于初始核的回归；谱分析显示几何由少数方向主导；聚类与邻域分析将化合物归为可识别的超导家族，并把化学性质和关联电子性质相关但Tc差异很大的材料联系起来。
AI.conclusion: 训练后的切核可作为探测材料表示学习的实用探针，将性质预测与材料空间探索连接起来。

title: In Situ Thermal Preparation by CO$_2$-Laser and Chemical Characterization of Oxide Substrates Across Multiple Crystallographic Orientations
comment: 9 figures, 3 tables in the maintext; and 2 figures in the supplematary info
summary: Atomically flat and chemically controlled oxide substrate surfaces are essential for high-quality epitaxial growth of complex materials and heterostructures. Previous studies have demonstrated in situ thermal preparation of selected oxide substrates, primarily focusing on conventional low-index orientations such as SrTiO$_3$ (100) and LaAlO$_3$ (100). Here, we extend these methodologies to a broader range of oxide substrates and crystallographic orientations, including challenging polar surfaces. We present a systematic study of the in situ thermal preparation of SrTiO$_3$ (100), SrTiO$_3$ (111), GdScO$_3$ (110), LaAlO$_3$ (111), (LaAlO$_3$)$_{0.3}$(Sr$_2$AlTaO$_6$)$_{0.7}$ (001), and NdGaO$_3$ (110) single crystal substrates. The substrates are annealed in a vacuum chamber under a controlled oxygen background environment using a CO$_2$ laser heating system. The optimized annealing conditions produce atomically flat step-and-terrace structures, long-range surface crystallinity, and effectively clean surfaces across all the investigated substrates. Our results establish a versatile, reproducible, and broadly applicable platform for the in situ preparation of oxide substrates immediately prior to epitaxial growth. These results also provide practical guidelines for interface engineering and surface-sensitive investigations of complex materials.

AI.tldr: 该文系统研究了多种氧化物单晶衬底（含极性面）的原位热处理方法，用CO₂激光加热在控氧环境中退火，获得原子级平整台阶-平台结构。
AI.motivation: 高质量外延生长与异质结需要原子级平整、化学可控的氧化物衬底表面，但以往工作多局限于SrTiO₃(100)、LaAlO₃(100)等低指数常规取向，缺乏对其他取向特别是极性面的系统研究。
AI.method: 在真空腔中通入可控氧背景，采用CO₂激光加热系统对SrTiO₃(100)、SrTiO₃(111)、GdScO₃(110)、LaAlO₃(111)、LSAT(001)、NdGaO₃(110)六种单晶衬底进行原位退火，并优化退火条件。
AI.result: 优化条件下所有衬底均获得原子级平整的台阶-平台结构、长程表面结晶性和有效清洁的表面，涵盖极性面在内。
AI.conclusion: 建立了通用、可重复、可广泛适用的氧化物衬底原位制备平台，可在生长前即时处理，并为界面工程和表面敏感研究提供实用指南。

title: Chiral magnetic excitations in the RMn6Sn6 kagome metals (R=Tb, Ho, Er, and Y)
summary: Recent inelastic neutron scattering (INS) investigations of the kagome metal TbMn6Sn6 reveal novel chiral magnetic excitations associated with the kagome layer. These excitations appear to have an itinerant character with a large energy scale (> 100 meV) and heavy damping; however, the origin of these excitations, which are not predicted by local moment linear spin-wave theory, is not understood. Here, we use INS to show that chiral excitations are also found in RMn6Sn6 compounds with R=Tb, Ho, Er, and Y having uniaxial, tilted, planar ferrimagnet, and planar double-spiral magnetic structures, respectively. Thus, the chiral excitations exist regardless of the magnetic structure. Additionally, R=Er and Y demonstrate that the chiral mode intensity is weaker in planar magnetic structures, suggesting that excitations are transverse to the local Mn moment direction. The chiral excitations appear only at L=odd positions in the Brilloun zone, and correspond to chiral spin exciations of the same handedness within each kagome layer, and pi out-of-phase between layers.

AI.tldr: 在多种RMn6Sn6（R=Tb,Ho,Er,Y）化合物中均观测到无能隙手性磁激发，与磁结构无关，仅出现于布里渊区L=奇数位置，源于Kagome层内同手性、层间π反相的Mn手性自旋激发，暗示其起源可能与巡游电子有关。
AI.motivation: 此前在Kagome金属TbMn6Sn6的INS实验中发现与Kagome层相关的新型手性磁激发，表现为巡游特征（能量尺度>100 meV、强阻尼），但局域矩线性自旋波理论无法解释其来源。作者希望通过研究不同磁结构的相关化合物，厘清这些手性激发的起源及其与磁结构的关系。
AI.method: 对RMn6Sn6体系（R=Tb, Ho, Er, Y）进行非弹性中子散射（INS）测量。这四种化合物分别具有单轴铁磁、倾斜铁磁、面内铁磁和面内双螺旋等不同磁结构，通过比较不同磁结构下手性激发的有无、强度及动量位置来分析其性质。
AI.result: 所有四种化合物中均观测到手性激发，说明其存在与磁结构无关；Er和Y（面内磁结构）中手性模式强度较弱，表明激发横向于局部Mn矩方向；手性激发仅出现在布里渊区L=奇数位置，对应于每个Kagome层内同手性的手性自旋激发，且层间相位差为π（反相）。
AI.conclusion: RMn6Sn6中的手性磁激发是一种普遍现象，不依赖具体磁结构，且具有明确的层内同手性、层间反相特征，指向其非局域矩线性自旋波起源（可能为巡游电子机制），为理解Kagome金属中的非常规磁激发提供了新线索。

title: Steering of topological criticality in the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger chain via non-Hermitian substitutional impurities
summary: We investigate the topological phase in a one-dimensional Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chain in the presence of a finite concentration of non-Hermitian substitutional impurities. Our primary focus is the discovery of a deterministic mechanism to actively reconfigure the topological phase boundaries by introducing site-dependent, non-reciprocal intracell and intercell hopping amplitudes. Specifically, breaking the internal structural symmetry of the non-reciprocal impurity hoppings induces a targeted macroscopic displacement of the critical point. This mechanism allows for the controlled expansion or compression of the topological phase strictly via local defect asymmetry. We validate this boundary displacement through finite-size scaling analysis. The extracted correlation length critical exponents ($ν\approx 1.455$ and $ν\approx 1.397$ for symmetric and asymmetric configurations, respectively) confirm a disorder-induced departure from the pristine SSH universality class, with the exponent diverging at high defect densities. We also report an impurity-induced real-to-complex spectral transition geometrically characterized by the Non-Hermitian Skin Effect. Ultimately, our results establish how isolated non-Hermitian asymmetries cooperatively interact to deterministically shift macroscopic topological protection.

AI.tldr: 本文研究含有限浓度非厄米替位杂质的SSH链，提出通过断裂杂质的非互易跃迁结构对称性来确定性移动拓扑相边界，并用有限尺寸标度验证临界点位移与临界指数。
AI.motivation: 希望找到一种确定性机制，主动重构（而非被动接受）拓扑相边界，并理解孤立非厄米不对称性如何协同影响宏观拓扑保护。
AI.method: 在SSH链中引入格点依赖的非互易胞内/胞间跃迁杂质；破坏杂质跃迁的内部结构对称性；采用有限尺寸标度分析提取关联长度临界指数，并借助非厄米趋肤效应刻画谱由实到复的转变。
AI.result: 杂质结构不对称性导致临界点发生定向宏观位移，可实现拓扑相的受控扩张或压缩；对称与不对称构型下临界指数分别为ν≈1.455与ν≈1.397，偏离纯净SSH普适类，且在高缺陷密度下发散；同时观察到杂质诱导的实谱到复谱转变，并具非厄米趋肤效应几何特征。
AI.conclusion: 局域非厄米不对称性可协同作用，确定性地移动宏观拓扑相边界，为拓扑相的主动调控提供机制。

title: Nanocrystalline cubic boron arsenide growth on GaAs(100) by gas source molecular beam epitaxy
summary: Cubic boron arsenide (c-BAs) is a promising ultrahigh thermal conductivity semiconductor, but its direct synthesis on lattice-mismatched substrates remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate the synthesis of nanocrystalline c-BAs thin films on GaAs(100) substrates using gas source molecular beam epitaxy. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy reveals an optimal growth temperature window of 250-400 C to maintain near stoichiometry and suppress severe arsenic loss. Surface and structural characterizations via atomic force microscopy, reflection high-energy electron diffraction, and grazing-incidence X-ray diffraction demonstrate a Volmer-Weber 3D island growth mode and a preferential crystallographic alignment with the GaAs substrate. High-resolution transmission electron microscopy confirms a chemically sharp interface without gallium interdiffusion into the c-BAs layer. These findings establish an initial step for the integration of c-BAs into advanced thermal and optoelectronic platforms.

AI.tldr: 利用气源分子束外延在GaAs(100)衬底上合成纳米晶立方硼砷(c-BAs)薄膜，确定250-400°C最佳生长窗口，揭示Volmer-Weber岛状生长与界面特性。
AI.motivation: c-BAs是极具潜力的超高导热半导体，但在晶格失配衬底上直接合成困难，阻碍其集成到先进热学与光电子平台。
AI.method: 采用气源分子束外延在GaAs(100)上生长c-BAs薄膜；用XPS确定生长温度窗口；通过AFM、RHEED和掠入射XRD表征表面与结构；用高分辨TEM观察界面。
AI.result: 确定250-400°C为维持近化学计量比、抑制砷流失的最佳窗口；观察到位Volmer-Weber三维岛状生长模式及与衬底的择优取向；TEM证实界面化学突变、无Ga互扩散。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为c-BAs融入先进热学与光电子平台迈出第一步。

title: Magnetic-Field-Induced Darkening of Bright Excitons in a MoWSe$_2$ Monolayer Alloy
summary: Magnetic fields are widely used to brighten spin-forbidden dark excitons, but the inverse effect on an optically bright exciton has remained largely unexplored. We demonstrate the complementary phenomenon of magnetic-field-induced darkening of a bright exciton in Mo$_{0.68}$W$_{0.32}$Se$_2$. At 4.2 K, an in-plane magnetic field up to 25 T activates a dark-exciton line 14.2$\pm$1.3 meV below the bright exciton while suppressing the bright-exciton emission by about 85\%. A bright-dark mixing model quantitatively captures the coupled energy and intensity evolution with an effective in-plane $g$ factor of $|g_{\parallel}|=5.2\pm0.2$. Alloying is crucial to the effect, as it brings the system close to the bright-dark crossover, where a small bright-dark splitting is combined with unusually strong in-plane magnetic coupling. This places the system in a regime where field-induced level repulsion raises the bright-like branch and strongly depletes its thermal population. These results identify a general route to magnetic control of exciton populations through engineering of the bright-dark hierarchy.

AI.tldr: 在Mo0.68W0.32Se2中观测到磁场诱导亮激子"变暗"的互补效应：面内强磁场激活暗激子并压制亮激子发光约85%。
AI.motivation: 磁场增亮自旋禁戒暗激子已被广泛研究，但反向效应——磁场使光学亮激子变暗——几乎未被探索，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 对合金Mo0.68W0.32Se2在4.2 K下施加最高25 T面内磁场进行磁光光谱测量，并用亮-暗激子混合模型拟合能量与强度的耦合演化，提取有效面内g因子。
AI.result: 磁场激活位于亮激子下方14.2±1.3 meV的暗激子谱线，同时亮激子发光被压制约85%；混合模型定量再现能量与强度变化，|g∥|=5.2±0.2。合金化使体系接近亮-暗交叉点，兼具小劈裂与强面内磁耦合。
AI.conclusion: 该效应源于场致能级排斥抬高亮支并耗尽其热布居；通过调控亮-暗能级层级，可实现激子布居的磁性操控。

title: Charge-conserving creation and annihilation of topological phase singularities in atomically thin semiconductors
summary: Atomically thin transition metal dichalcogenides provide a promising material platform for optical phase manipulation, as rapid variations in their dielectric functions can give rise to topological phase singularities (PSs). However, PS evolution while preserving topological charge conservation has not yet been investigated in exciton enabled PS systems. Here, using atomically thin MoS2 films on sapphire as a model system, we theoretically and experimentally demonstrate that the evolution of dielectric dispersion determines the creation, trajectory, merging, and annihilation of optical PSs under topological charge conservation. By varying the MoS2 film thickness, we experimentally realize this evolution through the gradual shrinking of the high energy n-k dispersion loop, which modifies its intersection with the zero reflection condition. Our results provide a general strategy for exploring and manipulating topological optical states.

AI.tldr: 以蓝宝石上原子级薄MoS2为模型，理论结合实验证明介电色散演化在拓扑荷守恒下决定光学相位奇点的产生、轨迹、合并与湮灭，并通过改变MoS2薄膜厚度实现该演化。
AI.motivation: 原子级薄过渡金属二硫化物介电函数变化剧烈，可产生拓扑相位奇点（PS），但激子enabled的PS系统中，PS演化过程中的拓扑荷守恒尚未被研究。
AI.method: 以蓝宝石衬底上原子级薄MoS2薄膜为模型体系，理论与实验相结合；通过改变MoS2薄膜厚度，使高能n-k色散环逐渐收缩，从而改变其与零反射条件的交点，实现色散演化的调控。
AI.result: 实验实现了由介电色散演化驱动的PS产生、轨迹移动、合并与湮灭过程，且全过程遵循拓扑荷守恒。
AI.conclusion: 介电色散演化是调控拓扑光学相位奇点的通用机制，为探索与操控拓扑光学态提供了普适策略。

title: Rashba-controlled emergence and reversal of critical-field anisotropy in p-wave magnet--superconductor hybrids
comment: 14 pages, 10 figures. Submitted to Physical Review B on October 6, 2026
summary: We show that tuning Rashba spin-orbit coupling can change the in-plane field direction along which an $s$-wave superconductor is most susceptible to Zeeman depairing. We consider a two-dimensional $s$-wave superconductor subject to an odd-parity exchange field induced by a $p$-wave magnet. Without Rashba coupling, the out-of-plane exchange field enhances the in-plane critical field but leaves its angular response exactly isotropic, despite the anisotropic magnetic spin texture. Minimizing the Bogoliubov--de Gennes grand potential over uniform singlet pairing, we find that increasing Rashba coupling first generates and then reverses the principal-axis critical-field contrast, switching the minimum-critical-field direction by $90^{\circ}$. Equal principal-axis fields at the intervening compensation point coexist with residual angular modulation. We interpret the reversal through competing momentum-dependent depairing contributions from the magnetic and Rashba spin textures, while the on-site singlet pairing channel remains unchanged. Direction-dependent discontinuous collapses of the order parameter further shape the critical-field curves. These results identify a tunable directional paramagnetic response within the uniform-pairing sector. In heterostructures with sufficient electrostatic tunability of interfacial Rashba coupling, this reversal would enable gate control of the easy-depairing axis without reorienting the magnetic texture.

AI.tldr: 在p波磁体诱导奇宇称交换场的二维s波超导体中，调节Rashba自旋轨道耦合可产生并反转面内上临界场的主轴各向异性，使最易退配对方向旋转90°，且无需重新取向磁结构。
AI.motivation: 探究Rashba自旋轨道耦合能否调控s波超导体在面内磁场下对Zeeman退对配的各向异性方向，从而在不改变磁织构的前提下实现易退配对轴的电控。
AI.method: 考虑受p波磁体诱导的奇宇称交换场作用的二维s波超导体，对均匀单重态配对最小化Bogoliubov–de Gennes巨正则势，系统改变Rashba耦合强度，计算上临界场的角度依赖。
AI.result: 无Rashba耦合时，尽管磁自旋织构各向异性，面内临界场角响应严格各向同性，面外交换场仅抬高面内临界场。增大Rashba耦合先产生、后反转主轴临界场对比，使最小临界场方向切换90°；在补偿点两主轴临界场相等但仍存在残余角调制。方向依赖的序参量不连续塌缩进一步塑造临界场曲线。
AI.conclusion: 在均匀配对框架内揭示了可调的方向性顺磁响应，归因于磁织构与Rashba织构的动量依赖退配对竞争。在界面Rashba耦合静电可调的异质结中，可实现易退配对轴的栅压控制。

title: Magnetic-Field Effects on the Electronic States of the K$_4$ Lattice
summary: We investigate the electronic states of the K$_4$ lattice in a uniform magnetic field within a nearest-neighbor tight-binding model. The K$_4$ lattice is a \rev{noncentrosymmetric three-dimensional network with triple-Dirac cones at the $Γ$ and H points}. By fixing the Bloch momentum component parallel to the field, the Peierls-substituted tight-binding problem reduces to an effective two-dimensional problem and yields a Hofstadter spectrum \rev{whose self-similar subpatterns reflect the geometry of the lattice projected onto the plane perpendicular to the field}. A square-like substructure emerges on the flux scale $φ= 1/8$ for $\bm{B}\parallel[100]$, and honeycomb- and triangular-like substructures emerge on the finer scale $φ= 1/32$ for $\bm{B}\parallel[111]$\rev{. Here $φ$ is the flux through the elementary plaquette of the projected lattice, and these scales correspond to one flux quantum per projected unit cell. Owing to the screw axes of the chiral K$_4$ network, the field-parallel momentum acts as an additional flux, which, for commensurate values of this momentum, shifts the spectrum along the flux axis and brings the second triple-Dirac cone at the H point into the magnetic spectrum}. In the weak-field limit, we derive the Landau-level structure from a low-energy effective Hamiltonian around the $Γ$ point. The three-component nature of the triple-Dirac cone gives rise to a cubic secular equation, whose solutions describe how a pseudospin-flat branch coexists with two relativistic Landau ladders \rev{and a single chiral $n=0$ level dispersing linearly along the field, in agreement with the lattice calculation}.

AI.tldr: 研究K₄晶格在均匀磁场下的电子态，用近邻紧束缚模型得出Hofstadter谱，揭示其自相似结构与晶格投影几何的对应关系，并推导弱场下的朗道能级结构。
AI.motivation: K₄晶格具有三狄拉克锥等新奇拓扑电子结构，但其在磁场下的量子化行为（Hofstadter谱、朗道能级）尚不清楚，需系统研究。
AI.method: 采用近邻紧束缚模型并作Peierls替换；固定平行于磁场的Bloch动量分量，将三维问题约化为有效二维问题求Hofstadter谱；再在Γ点附近构建低能有效哈密顿量推导弱场朗道能级。
AI.result: B∥[100]时在φ=1/8出现类方形子结构；B∥[111]时在更细的φ=1/32尺度出现类蜂窝与类三角子结构。螺旋轴使平行磁场动量充当附加磁通，在公度值时可将H点第二个三狄拉克锥移入磁谱。弱场下三能带久期方程给出一个赝自旋平坦支、两个相对论性朗道阶梯及沿磁场线性色散的单一手性n=0能级，与晶格计算一致。
AI.conclusion: K₄晶格的磁场谱具有由投影几何决定的自相似结构，且三狄拉克锥产生独特的朗道能级（平坦支+双相对论阶梯+单一手性零模），为研究非中心对称三维晶格的磁输运与拓扑性质提供基础。

title: Finite-temperature spectral functions of lattice polarons with process tensors
summary: We develop a process tensor approach for calculating the finite-temperature spectral functions of lattice polarons. We show that the finite-temperature phonon influence functional can be expressed as the elementwise exponential of a low-rank matrix product state, enabling an efficient summation of electron worldlines. An embedding construction embeds worldlines of different propagation times into a single matrix product state. This construction yields the propagator over the full simulated time interval in a single calculation. We benchmark this approach against available finite-temperature density-matrix renormalization group results for the one-dimensional Holstein polaron. We further obtain numerically converged spectra for the two-dimensional Holstein polaron. The spectra reveal a progressive transfer of spectral weight from coherent spectral features into an incoherent background with increasing temperature.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种过程张量方法，用于计算晶格极化子的有限温度谱函数，通过对低秩矩阵乘积态逐元素取指数来表达声子影响泛函，实现电子世界线的高效求和，并在一维和二维Holstein极化子上进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 有限温度下晶格极化子谱函数的精确计算具有挑战性，现有方法（如有限温度DMRG）在效率和可扩展性上存在局限，需要一种能高效求和电子世界线并覆盖全时间区间的方法。
AI.method: 提出基于过程张量的方法：证明有限温度声子影响泛函可表示为低秩矩阵乘积态的逐元素指数，从而高效求和电子世界线；并采用嵌入构造，将不同传播时间的世界线嵌入单一矩阵乘积态中，使一次计算即可获得整个模拟时间区间的传播子。
AI.result: 在一维Holstein极化子上与现有有限温度DMRG结果进行了基准对比验证；进一步获得了二维Holstein极化子数值收敛的谱。谱表明随温度升高，谱权重从相干谱特征逐步转移到非相干背景中。
AI.conclusion: 该过程张量方法可高效、精确地计算有限温度晶格极化子谱函数，并可推广到二维体系，揭示了温度驱动的谱权重由相干向非相干转移的物理行为。

title: Orbital Magnetization within Self-Consistent Hartree-Fock via an Envelope Theorem
summary: Orbital magnetization is an elementary thermodynamic response function of a quantum system: the derivative of the grand potential with respect to magnetic field. However, naive perturbation theory is fraught with difficulties, as even infinitesimal magnetic fields shatter any bands into a Hofstadter butterfly spectrum. Even at the self-consistent Hartree-Fock (mean field) level, rigorous formulas for the orbital magnetization have only become available within the last year. This work provides a straightforward derivation of orbital magnetization at the mean field level using a completely real-space approach. The key tools used are the magnetic perturbation theory developed in the 1960s and an envelope theorem, which is a standard result in the calculus of variations. For simplicity, we restrict to insulating states at zero temperature on the infinite plane. We also discuss the natural connections to projected position operators and quantum geometry, as well as practical numerical computations.

AI.tldr: 本文用完全实空间方法，在平均场（自洽 Hartree-Fock）层面给出了轨道磁化的简洁推导，核心工具是 1960 年代的磁微扰论与变分学中的包络定理，并讨论了与投影位置算符、量子几何的联系及数值计算。
AI.motivation: 轨道磁化是量子体系的基本热力学响应函数（大势对磁场的导数），但朴素微扰论失效：任意小的磁场都会把能带击碎成 Hofstadter 蝴蝶谱；即便在自洽 Hartree-Fock 平均场层面，严格的轨道磁化公式也直到最近一年才出现。作者希望提供一个更透明、易理解的推导路径。
AI.method: 采用完全实空间的方法，而非动量空间或半经典图像。关键工具为两类：(1) 1960 年代发展起来的磁微扰论；(2) 变分学中的标准结论——包络定理，用于处理自洽（平均场）条件下求导时波函数/密度不作为独立变量的问题。为简化，限定于零温无限平面上的绝缘态。
AI.result: 给出平均场层面轨道磁化的严格且直接的推导，得到不依赖 Hofstadter 谱细节的表达式；并阐明该结果与投影位置算符、量子几何（如 Berry 曲率等几何量）之间的自然联系，同时讨论了实际数值计算的可行方案。
AI.conclusion: 轨道磁化可在实空间中以磁微扰论加包络定理简洁导出，避免了能带碎裂带来的困难；该框架把平均场磁化与量子几何、投影位置算符统一起来，并为数值实现提供了实用路径。

title: Persistent Photo-Enhancement of Molecular Orbital Excitations in the Kondo Insulator FeSb$_2$
summary: When insulators are excited by photons with above-gap energies, photo-doped carriers are transiently generated. Typically, orbital excitations weaken and broaden due to increased screening by these transient carriers, followed by a few-ps recovery via phonon thermalization. Here we report the observation of anomalous dynamics of many-body molecular orbital excitations in the narrow-gap Kondo insulator FeSb$_2$. In the pumped X-ray absorption spectra following excitation with 1~$μ$m photons, we observe a transient transfer of absorption intensity from the delocalized states at the main absorption peak to the localized molecular orbital states at the pre-edge. At the resonance of the low-energy molecular orbital excitations, the pumped resonant inelastic X-ray spectra show an approximately 30\% intensity increase at a pump fluence of 11 mJ/cm$^2$ concomitant with the emergence of an energy gain feature. While the energy gain feature disappears after about 1-2~ps, the increased molecular orbital excitation intensities partially persist for at least 50~ps with no discernible energy shift. These observations require the invocation of a many-body excitation picture beyond single particle population changes.

AI.tldr: 本文报道窄带隙近藤绝缘体FeSb2中多体分子轨道激发的反常动力学：光激发后吸收强度从离域态转移到局域分子轨道态，共振非弹性X射线散射强度增加约30%并出现能量增益特征，增益特征1-2 ps消失但增强的轨道激发强度可持续至少50 ps且无能量移动，需用多体激发图像而非单粒子布居变化解释。
AI.motivation: 常规绝缘体中光生载流子通过增强屏蔽使轨道激发变弱变宽，并在数皮秒内经声子热化恢复。作者希望探究窄带隙近藤绝缘体FeSb2中强关联多体效应对光激发轨道动力学的影响，检验单粒子图像是否适用。
AI.method: 用1 μm光子泵浦FeSb2，测量泵浦-探测X射线吸收谱与共振非弹性X射线散射谱（RIXS），在低能分子轨道激发共振处考察强度与能量随延迟时间的变化，泵浦注量11 mJ/cm²。
AI.result: 泵浦XAS显示吸收强度从主吸收峰对应的离域态瞬态转移至前边局域分子轨道态；RIXS在分子轨道共振处强度增加约30%，并出现能量增益特征。能量增益特征约1-2 ps后消失，而分子轨道激发强度增强部分持续至少50 ps且无明显能量移动。
AI.conclusion: FeSb2中光激发轨道响应不同于常规绝缘体的屏蔽致宽化，表现出强度重分布与长寿命增强，无法用单粒子布居变化解释，需引入多体激发（如近藤/强关联分子轨道多体态）图像。

title: Lattice symmetry breaking and strain control of single-$\mathbf{q}$ magnetism in Na$_3$Co$_2$SbO$_6$
summary: Distinguishing single-$\mathbf{q}$ from multi-$\mathbf{q}$ magnetism constrains microscopic spin Hamiltonians. Here we determine the ground state of the candidate Kitaev magnet Na$_3$Co$_2$SbO$_6$ through its coupling to the lattice. High-resolution neutron diffraction reveals a spontaneous monoclinic-to-triclinic distortion at the magnetic transition, in contrast to the absence of detectable lattice-symmetry breaking in triple-$\mathbf{q}$ Na$_2$Co$_2$TeO$_6$. Together with strain-selective magnetic responses, this identifies single-$\mathbf{q}$ order in Na$_3$Co$_2$SbO$_6$ over the proposed symmetry-preserving double-$\mathbf{q}$ state. Uniaxial compression along a low-symmetry in-plane direction achieves the domain selection that magnetic-field training could not, revealing the intrinsic field-induced phase boundaries of the dominant domain. These results establish strain as a symmetry-conjugate field for magnetic domains and highlight magnetoelastic coupling as a route to diagnose, manipulate, and potentially tune magnetic states.

AI.tldr: 通过高分辨中子衍射与应变选择性磁测量，确定候选Kitaev磁体Na3Co2SbO6的基态为单q磁序而非双q态，并证明单轴应变可作为磁畴的对称共轭场实现磁畴选择与相界测量。
AI.motivation: 区分单q与多q磁性对约束微观自旋哈密顿量至关重要；Na3Co2SbO6此前被提出可能存在保持对称性的双q基态，而磁场训练无法实现磁畴选择，需要一种独立手段判定基态磁序并操控磁畴。
AI.method: 利用磁-晶格耦合作为探针：高分辨中子衍射探测磁转变处的晶格畸变；与三q的Na2Co2TeO6对比；结合应变选择性磁响应；并施加沿低对称面内方向的单轴压缩进行磁畴选择，测量主导畴的本征场诱导相界。
AI.result: 在磁转变处观察到自发的单斜-三斜畸变，而三q的Na2Co2TeO6无对称性破缺迹象；结合应变选择性磁响应，确认Na3Co2SbO6为单q磁序；单轴压缩沿低对称面内方向成功实现磁畴选择（磁场训练无法做到），并揭示了主导畴的本征场诱导相界。
AI.conclusion: 应变是磁畴的对称共轭场，磁弹性耦合可作为诊断、操控乃至调控磁态的有效途径。

title: Pressure-induced superconductivity in a bilayer metal
summary: We propose a model that explains the mechanism of pressure-induced superconductivity in a bilayer metal. Four types of pair potentials are assumed for a Cooper pair consisting of two electrons on different layers. Absence of local inversion symmetry gives rise to the spin-orbit coupling which is antisymmetric in the two layers. We assume that external pressure enhances the hybridization between the two layers. The stability of the superconducting states is well explained by the frequency symmetry of the induced pairing correlations by these potentials. Pressure-induced superconductivity emerges when the following two conditions are realized. (i) The spin-orbit coupling induces the odd-frequency pairing correlations and suppresses superconductivity at ambient pressure. (ii) The interplay between the spin-orbit coupling and the hybridization induces the additional pairing correlation that belongs to an even-frequency symmetry class. We briefly discuss the relevance of our model to real materials.

AI.tldr: 提出一个解释双层金属中压力诱导超导机理的模型：层间反演对称性破缺引起反对称自旋轨道耦合，压力增强层间杂化，通过频率对称性分析阐明超导态稳定性。
AI.motivation: 解释双层金属在加压下出现超导的物理机制，特别是局域反演对称性缺失带来的自旋轨道耦合与压力增强的层间杂化如何共同影响超导稳定性。
AI.method: 针对分布在两层上的库珀对假设四种配对势，考虑缺失局域反演对称性导致层间反对称的自旋轨道耦合，并假定外压增强双层杂化；借助这些势诱导的配对关联在频率上的对称性来分析超导态的稳定性。
AI.result: 压力诱导超导需满足两个条件：(i) 自旋轨道耦合诱导奇频配对关联，在常压下抑制超导；(ii) 自旋轨道耦合与杂化的相互作用诱导出属于偶频对称类的额外配对关联。并简要讨论了模型对实际材料的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 双层金属的压力诱导超导可由自旋轨道耦合诱导的奇频关联与杂化协同产生的偶频关联之间的竞争/互补来理解，模型可为真实材料提供解释框架。

title: Symmetry Enriched Criticality from Kennedy Tasaki Self-Duality
comment: 17 pages, 8 figures. Any comments or suggestions are welcome!
summary: The interplay between topology and quantum criticality has established symmetry enriched criticality as a new paradigm beyond conventional frameworks in condensed matter and statistical physics. However, the conditions under which such criticality emerges remain poorly understood. In this work, we show that a broad class of symmetry enriched critical points separating symmetry protected topological (SPT) and spontaneous symmetry breaking (SSB) phases is governed by Kennedy Tasaki (KT) self duality. At these criticalities, the KT transformation that interchanges the SPT and SSB phases acts as a self-dual noninvertible symmetry, endowing the critical points with nontrivial topological characteristics. We numerically demonstrate this mechanism in $\mathbb{Z}_{n} \times \mathbb{Z}_{n}$ cluster qudit chains and further argue that it naturally extends to higher dimensions, providing a duality based criterion for identifying symmetry-enriched criticality across dimensions.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一类分离SPT相与SSB相的对称富集临界点由Kennedy-Tasaki(KT)自对偶性支配，KT变换在临界点成为自对偶非可逆对称，赋予其拓扑特性。
AI.motivation: 拓扑与量子临界性的交织形成对称富集临界性这一新范式，但其出现的条件仍不清楚，缺乏判别准则。
AI.method: 通过理论分析证明SPT-SSB临界点受KT自对偶性支配，并在ℤₙ×ℤₙ cluster qudit链上进行数值验证，进而论证可推广至高维。
AI.result: 在cluster qudit链中数值验证了该机制；KT变换起自对偶非可逆对称作用，使临界点具有非平庸拓扑特征；该机制自然延伸至高维。
AI.conclusion: 给出一个基于对偶性的判据，可用于跨维度识别对称富集临界性。

title: Andreev Scattering Driven Surface Photogalvanic Effect
summary: The surface photogalvanic effect is a powerful tool for generating macroscopic direct currents in centrosymmetric film structures via asymmetric scattering of carriers at film boundaries. Here, we uncover a fundamentally distinct regime of photoinduced transport in normal metal-superconductor heterostructures, in which the macroscopic photocurrent is governed by Andreev scattering at the interface rather than by classical scattering. We demonstrate that the interplay between asymmetric surface scattering and Andreev retroreflection yields a giant, strongly frequency-dependent anomalous photocurrent. Strikingly, the electron-hole conversion at the normal-superconducting interface dictates a macroscopic sign reversal of the photogalvanic current across the superconducting transition, and induces non-analytic spectral kinks exactly at the pairing gap frequency. Our results establish the Andreev reflection-driven surface photogalvanic effect as a platform for optical control of superconducting correlations and suggest a direct, non-invasive spectroscopic probe for gap dynamics in hybrid quantum devices.

AI.tldr: 该文揭示了金属-超导异质结中由安德烈夫反射主导的表面光伏效应，发现超导转变时宏观光电流发生符号反转，且谱在配对能隙频率处出现非解析拐折。
AI.motivation: 传统表面光伏效应依赖薄膜边界处载流子的非对称经典散射来产生宏观直流电流。作者希望探究在正常金属-超导异质结中，界面处的安德烈夫散射是否会取代经典散射成为光致输运的主导机制，从而开辟新的物理机制与探测手段。
AI.method: 理论分析金属-超导异质结中的光致输运，将非对称表面散射与安德烈夫回反射相结合，考察界面电子-空穴转换对光电流的贡献，并计算光电流随频率与超导态的依赖关系。
AI.result: 非对称表面散射与安德烈夫回反射的协同作用产生了巨大的、强频率依赖的反常光电流；超导界面处的电子-空穴转换导致光电流在超导转变两侧发生宏观符号反转，并在恰好等于配对能隙频率处诱导出非解析谱拐折。
AI.conclusion: 安德烈夫反射驱动的表面光伏效应可作为光调控超导关联的平台，并为混合量子器件中的能隙动力学提供直接、非侵入式的光谱探测手段。

title: Non-uniform grids to accelerate electron-phonon coupling calculations for superconductivity
summary: Efficient and accurate evaluation of electron-phonon interactions is essential for predictive superconductivity calculations, but dense Brillouin zone sampling requirements pose a major computational bottleneck. To overcome this, we introduce an accelerated, highly scalable framework that combines a double delta truncation scheme with non-uniform Farey grids in both $\mathbf{k}$ and $\mathbf{q}$ space. The truncation strategy significantly reduces computational cost by restricting integration to states satisfying energy constraints near the Fermi level, while the Farey grids dynamically resolve sampling errors from localized scattering and stabilize convergence. Applied to elemental aluminium and several high-pressure hydrides, this combined methodology reduces computational cost by up to two orders of magnitude and yields electron-phonon coupling constants and superconducting critical temperatures Tc typically within about 5% of full-grid benchmarks. This approach overcomes sampling bottlenecks associated with dense uniform grids, making accurate, low-cost predictions of superconductivity in complex quantum materials feasible.

AI.tldr: 提出结合双重delta截断与非均匀Farey网格的加速框架，将电声耦合与超导Tc计算成本降低最多两个数量级，精度约5%。
AI.motivation: 电声耦合的精确计算对超导预测至关重要，但布里渊区稠密采样是主要计算瓶颈，稠密均匀网格成本过高，亟需高效高精度采样方案。
AI.method: 在k和q空间同时采用双重delta截断（仅保留费米面附近满足能量约束的态）与非均匀Farey网格（动态分辨局域散射带来的采样误差并稳定收敛）。
AI.result: 应用于铝及多种高压氢化物，计算成本最多降低两个数量级，电声耦合常数与Tc通常在全网格基准的约5%偏差内。
AI.conclusion: 该方法克服稠密均匀网格的采样瓶颈，使复杂量子材料超导性的准确低成本预测成为可能。

title: Superconducting weak links at substrate steps in bilayer nickelate films
summary: Ambient-pressure superconductivity above 40 K has been realized in bilayer nickelate thin films on SrLaAlO$_4$ (001), yet resistive measurements often exhibit incomplete zero-resistance states and/or two-step superconducting transitions of unresolved origin. We show that these features arise from superconducting weak links at substrate step-terrace structures. A direct correlation between the azimuthal-angle-dependent two-step transition and step-terrace orientation establishes this connection, further supported by atomic-scale visualization of structurally disrupted regions at step terraces. Modeling the films as pristine (weak-link) regions with higher (lower) transition temperature reproduces essential features of the two-step transition using both a simple model and finite-element simulations. Transport measurements further reveal a strong dependence of transition characteristics - and even the occurrence of superconductivity itself - on average terrace width. These results identify step-induced weak links as the microscopic origin of two-step transitions in bilayer nickelate films, providing a framework for understanding anisotropic and percolative transport, and a route to superconducting devices.

AI.tldr: 双层镍酸盐薄膜中两步超导转变与不完全零电阻源于衬底台阶-平台结构诱导的超导弱连接。
AI.motivation: 在SrLaAlO4(001)上的双层镍酸盐薄膜虽实现40 K以上常压超导，但电阻测量常出现不完整零电阻态和来源不明的两步超导转变，其微观机制尚不清楚。
AI.method: 建立方位角依赖的两步转变与台阶-平台取向的相关性；用原子级成像观察台阶处的结构破坏区；将薄膜建模为具有较高转变温度的完整区与较低转变温度的弱连接区，结合简单模型与有限元模拟；并测量转变特性对平均平台宽度的依赖。
AI.result: 方位角依赖的两步转变与台阶-平台取向直接相关，并被台阶处结构破坏的原子级观测所支持；模型再现两步转变的主要特征；转变特性乃至超导是否出现强烈依赖平均平台宽度。
AI.conclusion: 台阶诱导的弱连接是双层镍酸盐薄膜两步超导转变的微观起源，为理解各向异性与渗流输运提供框架，并为超导器件提供途径。

title: Good-$Γ$ Numbers: A Shell-Optimized Route to the Thermodynamic Limit in Quantum Monte Carlo Calculations of the High-Density Two-Dimensional Electron Gas
summary: Single-particle finite-size errors remain a central obstacle in quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) simulations of periodic systems, conventionally reduced via twist averaging (TA). Here we introduce Good-$Γ$ (GG) particle numbers as system sizes $N$ at which the $Γ$-point Hartree--Fock (HF) energy of the high-density two-dimensional uniform electron gas (2D UEG) lies anomalously close to its thermodynamic-limit (TL) value. All results in this work concern the 2D UEG in its high-density Fermi-liquid regime, $r_s=1$--$4$. We systematically investigate the kinetic- and exchange-energy errors, $ΔKE(N)$ and $ΔEX(N)$, that underlie this one-body finite-size-error cancellation across four densities and both spin polarizations. We then compare diffusion Monte Carlo (DMC) energies extrapolated to the TL from GG-$N$ sequences against twist-averaged extrapolations at the same densities and polarizations, finding agreement to within a fraction of a millihartree in every case, independent of whether a $1/N$ or an $N^{-5/4}$ extrapolation form is used.

AI.tldr: 提出"Good-Γ"(GG)粒子数概念——在二维均匀电子气高密度区，Γ点Hartree–Fock能量恰好接近热力学极限的体系尺寸N；据此从GG-N序列外推的DMC能量与twist averaging结果一致到亚毫哈特里量级。
AI.motivation: 量子蒙特卡洛模拟周期体系时，单粒子有限尺寸误差是核心障碍，常规用twist averaging(TA)消除，但TA需对多个twist取样、计算开销大且随体系增大成本高。作者希望找到一种无需twist取样的有效尺寸选择方案。
AI.method: 定义GG粒子数：使Γ点HF能量异常接近热力学极限值的N。在高密度费米液体区(r_s=1–4)、两种自旋极化、四个密度下，系统分析动能与交换能误差ΔKE(N)与ΔEX(N)，解释单粒子有限尺寸误差抵消机制；再将GG-N序列的DMC能量外推至热力学极限，与同密度同极化下的twist averaging外推对比，并检验1/N与N^{-5/4}两种外推形式。
AI.result: 所有情形下，GG-N外推与twist averaging外推的DMC能量一致，差异在几分之一毫哈特里以内，且与所采用的外推形式（1/N或N^{-5/4}）无关。
AI.conclusion: GG粒子数可作为一种廉价、可靠的替代方案，在不需要twist averaging的情况下有效抑制二维UEG的单粒子有限尺寸误差，为周期体系QMC计算提供新的尺寸选择策略。

title: Spin fluctuations and nearly isotropic quasiparticles in the doped three-dimensional Hubbard model
summary: Away from half filling and above its Neel temperature, the three-dimensional Hubbard model is a paramagnetic metal with antiferromagnetic spin fluctuations, where controlled momentum-resolved results have been lacking. Using connected-determinant diagrammatic Monte Carlo, we compute the momentum-resolved self-energy for n = 0.4-0.95, T/t = 0.05-0.33 and U/t = 4-8, and the full-zone spin susceptibility at twelve of these points, focusing on U/t = 4. At U/t = 4 and toward half filling the spin fluctuations become strong: for n = 0.7-0.9 at T/t = 0.14 they enhance the susceptibility peak up to sevenfold and raise the momentum-dependent part of the scattering rate to four to five times its second-order value. They are driven by an effective spin interaction screened to about 2U/3 and nearly uniform over the zone. Yet the peak height is set by the slightly smaller value of this interaction at the peak wave vector, and near magnetic order this small difference changes the height by a large factor. Two-particle self-consistent theory reproduces the peak because its sum rule fixes its single constant interaction near this value, but for n = 0.7-0.9 at T/t = 0.14 its self-energy overestimates the local scattering rate and underestimates the momentum-dependent part. Though strong, the fluctuations are short ranged, with a correlation length of at most about two lattice spacings, and for n = 0.7-0.9 and T/t >= 0.14 the scattering rate near the Fermi surface varies by at most about 1% at fixed band energy, without hot spots. At U/t = 4 dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT) reproduces the local scattering rate and quasiparticle weight within a few percent, and the nonlocal part it misses is approximately a function of the band energy. Strong spin fluctuations thus coexist with nearly isotropic quasiparticles, and the results provide a benchmark for extensions of DMFT and for spin-fluctuation theories.

AI.tldr: Using connected-determinant diagrammatic Monte Carlo, the authors compute momentum-resolved self-energy and spin susceptibility of the 3D Hubbard model away from half filling, finding strong but short-ranged spin fluctuations that coexist with nearly isotropic quasiparticles.
AI.motivation: Controlled momentum-resolved results for the paramagnetic metal with antiferromagnetic spin fluctuations in the 3D Hubbard model (away from half filling, above Neel temperature) have been lacking.
AI.method: Connected-determinant diagrammatic Monte Carlo is used to compute the momentum-resolved self-energy for n=0.4-0.95, T/t=0.05-0.33, U/t=4-8, plus full-zone spin susceptibility at twelve points (focus U/t=4); comparisons with two-particle self-consistent theory and DMFT.
AI.result: At U/t=4 near half filling, spin fluctuations enhance the susceptibility peak up to sevenfold and raise the momentum-dependent scattering rate to 4-5 times its second-order value; driven by an effective spin interaction screened to ~2U/3. Fluctuations are short ranged (correlation length ≲2 lattice spacings), scattering rate varies by ≤~1% at fixed band energy without hot spots. TPSC reproduces the peak but misestimates self-energy parts; DMFT reproduces local scattering rate and quasiparticle weight within a few percent.
AI.conclusion: Strong spin fluctuations coexist with nearly isotropic quasiparticles, providing a benchmark for extensions of DMFT and for spin-fluctuation theories.

title: Suppression and reemergence of directional transport across the ferromagnetic transition in SrRuO$_3$
summary: SrRuO$_3$ is a canonical itinerant ferromagnet that continues to serve as a fertile platform for exploring spin-orbit coupled transport and topological responses in correlated oxide metals. Here, we investigate a (110)-oriented epitaxial SrRuO3 thin film on DyScO$_3$, where crystallographic anisotropy allows for symmetry-resolved charge transport along orthogonal in-plane directions. We uncover two principal findings. First, the resistance above the Curie temperature $T_{c,on}\approx 165$ K exhibits strong anisotropy, consistent with directionally dependent spin-fluctuation scattering. Below $T_{c,on}$, this anisotropy nearly vanishes, despite persistent structural inequivalence, due to isotropic electron-magnon and electron-electron scattering processes. Second, the application of a magnetic field reveals a striking directional contrast in the linear magnetoresistance (MR): it remains negative and saturates along [001], but changes sign and becomes positive along $[1\bar{1}0]$ below $T_0=145$ K. In contrast, the quadratic MR term is identical for both directions and peaks near $T_{\mathrm{OHE}}^*=155$ K, where the ordinary Hall coefficient crosses zero, consistent with carrier compensation under a two-band scenario. A sign change in the anomalous Hall signal at $T_{\mathrm{AHE}}^*=150$ K is consistent with a temperature-dependent redistribution of Berry-curvature contributions near the Fermi level. These results establish ferromagnetic ordering as the primary driver of the observed directional magnetotransport in SrRuO$_3$.

AI.tldr: 在(110)取向SrRuO3薄膜中，磁有序主导了方向依赖的各向异性磁输运，揭示了自旋涨落散射与两带载流子补偿、Berry曲率重分布的关系。
AI.motivation: SrRuO3是研究关联氧化物中自旋-轨道耦合输运与拓扑响应的典型巡游铁磁体，但晶体各向异性如何影响磁输运（尤其各向异性磁电阻与线性磁电阻的方向依赖）尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在DyScO3衬底上生长(110)取向外延SrRuO3薄膜，利用晶体各向异性实现沿两个正交面内方向([001]与[1-1 0])的对称分辨电荷输运测量，系统研究电阻各向异性、线性与二次磁电阻、普通/反常霍尔效应随温度的演化。
AI.result: 1) 在Tc,on≈165 K以上电阻呈现强各向异性（方向依赖的自旋涨落散射），低于Tc,on时各向异性几乎消失（各向同性电子-磁振子与电子-电子散射）。2) 线性磁电阻方向对比显著：[001]方向为负且饱和，而[1-1 0]方向在T0=145 K以下变号为正；二次磁电阻两项相同，在TOHE*=155 K（普通霍尔系数过零，符合两带载流子补偿）附近达峰。3) 反常霍尔信号在TAHE*=150 K变号，符合费米面附近Berry曲率贡献的温度依赖重分布。
AI.conclusion: 铁磁有序是SrRuO3中方向依赖磁输运的主要驱动因素，为利用晶向调控自旋-轨道耦合与拓扑输运提供了途径。

title: Accelerating real-time hybrid-functional calculations with learned ACE and symmetry-based FFT reuse
summary: Real-time hybrid-functional calculations require repeated reconstruction of nonlocal exchange, whose cost grows rapidly with Brillouin-zone sampling. We develop two methods to improve the efficiency of time evolution and spatial processing. The first learns the time evolution of adaptively compressed exchange (ACE) factors and predicts their updates, reducing the frequency of explicit reconstruction. The second uses crystal symmetry to reuse exchange fast Fourier transforms (FFTs) among equivalent real-space points. This symmetry-based FFT reuse (SBFR) reduces the number of FFTs while retaining the full $\bm k$-point sum. The methods can be used with a variety of hybrid functionals, and we use HSE06 in this work. Relative to an ACE reference using full-row mesh FFTs, learned prediction provides more than fivefold acceleration, SBFR more than fourteenfold, and their combination more than sixty-threefold. The combined method shows efficient parallel scaling. After learning, propagation takes less than 0.5 s per step. The reduced computational cost allows us to study nonlinear and nonequilibrium electron dynamics with hybrid functionals and to examine the role of excitonic effects in semiconductors and insulators.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出两种加速混合泛函实时计算的方法：学习自适应压缩交换(ACE)因子的时间演化以预测更新，以及利用晶体对称性复用交换FFT(SBFR)；两者结合相对ACE全行网格参考加速超过63倍。
AI.motivation: 实时混合泛函计算需反复重建非局域交换，其开销随布里渊区采样快速增大，成为限制非线性、非平衡电子动力学研究的瓶颈。
AI.method: 方法一：用学习模型拟合自适应压缩交换(ACE)因子的时间演化并预测其更新，减少显式重建频率；方法二：SBFR，利用晶体对称性在等价实空间点间复用交换FFT，在保留完整k点求和的前提下减少FFT次数。二者可配合多种混合泛函(本文用HSE06)。
AI.result: 相对使用全行网格FFT的ACE参考：学习预测加速>5倍，SBFR>14倍，二者结合>63倍；组合方法并行扩展性良好，学习后每步传播耗时<0.5秒。
AI.conclusion: 降低的计算成本使得可用混合泛函研究非线性与非平衡电子动力学，并考察半导体与绝缘体中的激子效应。

title: Collective Hall quantization in 3D Chern vector systems
comment: This manuscript substantially revises and supersedes our earlier preprint (arXiv:2501.14493), with a restructured presentation and a different scientific emphasis
summary: Understanding the three-dimensional (3D) quantum Hall effect, characterized by a Chern vector rather than a single Chern number, has been a central pursuit in topological physics. While quantized Hall transport is established for the special case with one nonzero Chern component, recent realizations of more general Chern-vector states raise a fundamental question: how does such topology protect quantized transport? Here, we predict a distinct 3D quantized Hall effect protected by $\mathbf{C}=(0,m,n)$. For samples with dimensions $L_y$ and $L_z$, global topology enforces collective quantization of $mL_y+nL_z$, despite the fragility of individual edge modes to disorder. This reveals a novel transport regime in which robust quantization emerges as a holistic property of a unified chiral network,rather than of its constituent modes. Crucially, this collective response manifests as a quantized Hall conductance $G_{xy}=\pm(mL_y+nL_z)e^2/h$, with a distinctive dependence on both Chern-vector components and sample dimensions. We propose candidate materials to facilitate experimental observation.

AI.tldr: 本文预测了由Chern矢量C=(0,m,n)保护的独特三维量子化霍尔效应：尽管单个边缘模对无序脆弱，全局拓扑强制要求对mL_y+nL_z进行集体量子化，霍尔电导G_xy=±(mL_y+nL_z)e²/h。
AI.motivation: 三维量子霍尔效应以Chern矢量（而非单一Chern数）为特征。已有量子化霍尔输运仅在单个非零Chern分量的特殊情形下建立，而更一般的Chern矢量态实验实现提出了根本问题：这种拓扑如何保护量子化输运？
AI.method: 理论预测：针对C=(0,m,n)的Chern矢量态，分析尺寸为L_y和L_z的样品中边缘模与全局拓扑的关系，指出各个边缘模对无序脆弱，但整体拓扑强制mL_y+nL_z的集体量子化，形成统一的 chiral 网络。
AI.result: 发现了一种新的输运机制：稳健的量子化不是来自单个模，而是作为统一手性网络的整体性质出现，表现为G_xy=±(mL_y+nL_z)e²/h，且依赖于Chern矢量分量与样品尺寸两者。
AI.conclusion: 提出可实验观测的候选材料，将三维量子化霍尔效应推广到一般Chern矢量情形，并揭示由样品尺寸调制的量子化霍尔电导新形式。

title: Atomic identification via the Prandtl-Tomlinson stick-slip mechanism
summary: Distinguishing atomic species is an ongoing challenge in the field of scanning probe microscopy. Typically, atomic force microscopy makes use of electrostatic interactions to perform atomic identification. Here we perform lateral force microscopy (LFM) measurements with a CO terminated tip of a partially oxidized Cu(110) surface and show clear differences between the metal and oxygen sites over a large z-range. This allows for atomic identification on a typical metal oxide. Density functional theory based calculations show that the tip-sample interaction is dominated by short-ranged orbital interactions and that the electrostatic contribution is negligible. At small tip-sample distances, LFM can probe the Prandtl-Tomlinson stick-slip mechanism on the single-atom scale. It is visible as a striking asymmetry in the forward and backward scan directions, experimentally revealing this fundamental model for nanotribology on the single-atom scale.

AI.tldr: 利用CO终端针尖对部分氧化的Cu(110)表面做横向力显微镜测量，在很大z范围内清晰区分金属位与氧位，实现金属氧化物上的原子识别；DFT表明相互作用由短程轨道作用主导、静电力可忽略，并在小距离下于单原子尺度观测到Prandtl-Tomlinson粘滑机制。
AI.motivation: 扫描探针显微术中区分原子种类仍是难题，传统原子力显微镜多依赖静电相互作用进行原子识别，本文希望用横向力显微镜提供另一条原子识别途径。
AI.method: 用CO终端针尖在部分氧化的Cu(110)表面进行横向力显微镜（LFM）测量，并结合密度泛函理论（DFT）计算分析针尖-样品相互作用来源。
AI.result: 在较大z范围内观察到金属位与氧位的明显差异，可用于金属氧化物上的原子识别；DFT显示相互作用由短程轨道作用主导、静电贡献可忽略；小针尖-样品距离下LFM可探测单原子尺度的Prandtl-Tomlinson粘滑机制，表现为正反扫描方向的显著不对称。
AI.conclusion: LFM配合CO终端针尖可实现典型金属氧化物上的原子种类识别；同时在单原子尺度实验揭示了纳米摩擦学的基本模型。原文摘要中未见DOI信息，以上为摘要层面的归纳。

title: A Transport-Information Framework for Continuous-Fiber-Aligned Coarse-Graining Representation Sets
summary: Consider representation sets of interest whose elements are associated with continuous realizations related to them through coarse-graining (CG). CG can be regarded as an operation that reduces a representation by discarding information that is not retained in its output. However, a systematic description of the information structure associated with CG in general remains to be established. Here, we propose a transport-information framework for continuous-fiber-aligned representation sets, in which each representation is associated with a continuous realization through a fiber structure, with CG defining the projection onto the representation. Within this framework, CG is described through a local-map operation that transports continuous probability mass onto representative points. The resulting transport cost is expressed as the contraction of the second-moment structure of the underlying continuous representation with the transport metric. Building on the previously proposed framework of unavoidable canonical nonlinearity (UCN), this construction provides a non-arbitrary information-theoretic interpretation of the CG-associated transport cost in terms of information indistinguishability, quantified by an expected Kullback-Leibler divergence associated with the CG geometry. The present framework provides a basis for describing information costs associated with individual CG operations and for comparing representation sets while accounting for their underlying continuous realizations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“传输-信息”框架，用纤维结构描述表示集与连续实现之间的粗粒化(CG)关系，并将CG刻画为把连续概率质量输运到代表点的局部映射。传输代价表示为连续表示的二阶矩结构与传输度量的收缩，并在UCN框架下给出基于KL散度的信息不可区分性解释。
AI.motivation: 粗粒化可视为丢弃信息的表示缩减操作，但关于CG所关联的信息结构的系统性描述尚未建立，缺少对单个CG操作信息代价的非任意刻画以及考虑连续实现来比较表示集的方法。
AI.method: 构建连续纤维对齐的表示集框架：每个表示通过纤维结构关联一个连续实现，CG定义为到表示的投影；用局部映射操作将连续概率质量输运到代表点，得到传输代价，并将其写成连续表示二阶矩结构与传输度量的收缩；借助已有的不可避免规范非线性(UCN)框架给出该代价的信息论解释。
AI.result: CG关联的传输代价可被解释为信息不可区分性，用与CG几何相关的期望KL散度量化，从而避免任意性解释。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为描述单个CG操作的信息代价、以及在考虑底层连续实现的情况下比较表示集提供了基础。

title: Early-stage local melting during solid-state sintering of a Cu-Ni-Ti-Zr-Hf alloy: A combined thermodynamic and kinetic analysis
comment: This is a preprint article distributed under the CC-BY license
summary: Complex concentrated alloys (CCAs) combining elements from 3d transition and refractory groups, specifically Cu-Ni-Ti-Zr-Hf-based shape memory systems, exhibit excellent functional properties but present significant manufacturing challenges via powder metallurgy. In this study, a non-equimolar Cu15Ni35Ti25Zr12.5Hf12.5 (at. %) alloy was successfully produced by induction melting, followed by atomization and subsequent consolidation via Spark Plasma Sintering (SPS) at temperatures ranging from 850 to 1100 C.
