Although global equilibrium phase diagrams predict solid-state stability up to 1260 C, localized melting unexpectedly occurred during SPS at 1100 C. By combining retrospective Scheil-Gulliver solidification simulations with 2D local equilibrium heat maps, we demonstrate that this early-stage melting is not driven by macroscopic thermal gradients, but by microsegregation inherited from atomization. During solid-state heating, thermally activated short-range diffusion, accelerated by high defect densities at particle interfaces, partitions Ti towards the interparticle network, leaving Cu-enriched regions (up to ~41 at. %) within the particle interiors. Owing to the strongly negative mixing enthalpy of Cu with Hf (-19.2 kJ/mol for $ΔH_{mix}^{l-l}$) and, to a lesser extent, with Ti, the local solidus of these Cu-rich regions is dramatically depressed. Upon heating to 1100 C, these regions cross their local solidus and form a liquid phase, whose solidification produces the Cu-Hf co-segregation. This framework accounts for localized melting phenomena in rapidly solidified CCA powders containing low-melting constituents with strong negative mixing enthalpies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了非等原子比Cu15Ni35Ti25Zr12.5Hf12.5形状记忆合金经雾化+SPS致密化过程中的异常局部熔化现象，指出根源是雾化遗留的微观偏析而非宏观温度梯度。
AI.motivation: Cu-Ni-Ti-Zr-Hf基复杂浓缩合金形状记忆性能优异，但粉末冶金制备困难；且全局平衡相图预测固相稳定至1260 °C，实际SPS在1100 °C却出现局部熔化，机制不明。
AI.method: 感应熔炼+雾化制粉+SPS（850–1100 °C）致密化；结合回溯式Scheil-Gulliver凝固模拟与二维局部平衡热图，分析局部固相线与偏析演化。
AI.result: 1100 °C SPS时发生局部熔化。颗粒界面高缺陷密度加速短程扩散，Ti向颗粒间网络偏聚，颗粒内部形成Cu富集区（高达约41 at.%）；Cu与Hf（ΔH_mix^l-l = -19.2 kJ/mol）及Ti的强负混合焓显著压低局部固相线，加热时越过固相线形成液相，其凝固导致Cu-Hf共偏析。
AI.conclusion: 含低熔点组元且具强负混合焓的快速凝固CCA粉末，其SPS局部熔化由雾化继承的微观偏析驱动，可由Scheil模拟+局部平衡热图预测，为粉末冶金工艺窗口设计提供依据。

title: On the origin of nonreciprocal charge transport in topological insulator BiSbTeSe2
summary: Nonreciprocal charge transport provides an effective approach for probing direction dependent charge dynamics and spin-momentum-locked electronic states. Here, we report highly gate-tunable nonreciprocal charge transport in dual-gated BiSbTeSe2 topological insulator device. The second-harmonic longitudinal resistance is linear in both current and magnetic field. The nonreciprocal response reaches its maximum near the charge neutrality point, exhibits sign reversals on either side, and is strongly suppressed once the Fermi level enters the bulk states. We suggest that the nonreciprocal response is attributed to the inhomogeneity of spin-momentum locking in the topological surface states. The nonreciprocal signal near the charge neutrality point is about one order of magnitude larger than that without gate modulation and remains robust up to 300 K, highlighting BiSbTeSe2 as a promising platform for room-temperature nonlinear electronics.

AI.tldr: 在双栅 BiSbTeSe2 拓扑绝缘体器件中观察到高度可栅调控的非互易电荷输运，其二次谐波纵向电阻随电流和磁场线性变化，在电荷中性点附近最强、两侧符号反转、费米能进入体态后被抑制，并可在 300 K 保持。
AI.motivation: 非互易电荷输运是探测方向相关电荷动力学与自旋-动量锁定电子态的有效手段，本文希望在此类拓扑表面态体系中实现并调控该效应。
AI.method: 制备双栅 BiSbTeSe2 拓扑绝缘体器件，通过栅压调控费米能级，测量二次谐波纵向电阻的非互易响应随电流、磁场及栅压的变化。
AI.result: 二次谐波纵向电阻对电流与磁场均呈线性；非互易响应在电荷中性点附近达到最大，两侧发生符号反转，费米能进入体态后被强烈抑制；栅调控下的信号比无栅调控时大约一个数量级，并在高达 300 K 仍保持稳健。作者将其归因于拓扑表面态中自旋-动量锁定的不均匀性。
AI.conclusion: BiSbTeSe2 中的可栅调控、室温稳健的非互易输运使其成为室温非线性电子学的有前景平台。

title: Classical-to-Quantum Transition in Blackbody Radiation Thermodynamics: Planck's Law without Statistical Assumptions
summary: Inspired by Fermi's model of radiation-matter interaction, we investigate the classical dynamics of a closed, finite-energy system, in which matter is coupled to an electromagnetic field. We find that energy is progressively transferred to increasingly high-frequency field modes, so that the effective temperature of both matter and radiation approaches zero in the long-time limit - in sharp contradiction with the finite-temperature equilibrium assumed by classical blackbody thermodynamics. Requiring consistency with the Stefan-Boltzmann and Wien laws identifies a characteristic time $t_L$, at which both laws are simultaneously satisfied. Strikingly, classical spectra obtained for different energies and cavity sizes collapse onto the universal Planck distribution at $t_L$. We conjecture that quantum dynamical localization arrests the classical energy cascade at $t_L$, and that the Planck distribution emerges as a dynamical consequence of this arrest - without invoking any a priori statistical assumption.

AI.tldr: 受费米辐射-物质耦合模型启发，研究闭合并具有限能量的经典电磁-物质系统动力学，发现能量向高频模式级联、有效温度趋于零；在特征时间 t_L 时经典谱坍缩为普朗克分布，并猜想量子动力学局域化使级联停滞从而"动态地"导出普朗克分布。
AI.motivation: 经典黑体热力学假定系统达到有限温度平衡，但闭合并具有限能量的经典辐射-物质耦合系统是否真能支撑这一假定并不清楚。作者希望检验经典动力学演化，并探索普朗克分布能否在无需先验统计假设的前提下自然涌现。
AI.method: 借鉴费米的辐射-物质相互作用模型，对闭合并具有限能量的经典系统进行数值/解析动力学分析，追踪能量在电磁场各频率模式间的转移；以斯特藩-玻尔兹曼定律与维恩定律的同时满足作为判据，确定特征时间 t_L，并比较不同能量与不同腔体尺寸的谱；最后以量子动力学局域化解释经典能量级联的停滞。
AI.result: 能量持续向越来越高的频率模式转移，物质与辐射的有效温度在长时极限均趋于零，与经典黑体热力学的有限温平衡假设直接矛盾；由两条黑体定律同时成立定出特征时间 t_L；在该时刻，不同能量和不同腔体尺寸所得到的经典谱均坍缩到同一条普适的普朗克分布上。
AI.conclusion: 经典辐射-物质耦合动力学并不支持有限温的经典黑体平衡，而是表现为向高频的能量级联。普朗克分布可被视为量子动力学局域化在 t_L 时刻阻止该级联后的动力学产物，从而无需引入任何先验的统计假设。这是以猜想形式提出的机制，尚待量子动力学层面的验证。

title: Thermodynamic Stability of Classical $\mathbb Z_2$ Lattice Gauge Models
summary: Finite-temperature phases are traditionally studied through spontaneous symmetry breaking, but symmetry-breaking fields can remove their distinction, as in the Ising model. This motivates the search for stable nontrivial thermal phases without symmetry protection. For classical $\mathbb Z_2$ lattice gauge models with spins on $m$-dimensional cells in a fixed spatial dimension $d$, we prove joint analyticity of the thermodynamic free-energy density in temperature and perturbation strength at sufficiently low positive temperatures under sufficiently weak local perturbations, whenever $1\le m\le d-2$. Perturbations need not preserve internal or gauge symmetries and may include noncommuting quantum interactions. A separate high-temperature expansion yields an analytic region reaching infinite temperature at any fixed finite perturbation strength. These results establish thermodynamic stability and support the conjecture that low- and high-temperature regimes remain separated by a thermal transition without symmetry protection.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，对于固定空间维数 d 中定义在 m 维胞腔自旋上的经典 Z₂ 格点规范模型（1 ≤ m ≤ d-2），在足够低的有限温度与足够弱的局域扰动下，热力学自由能密度对温度与扰动强度联合解析；扰动无需保持内部或规范对称性，甚至可为非对易量子相互作用。另给出高温展开的解析区域。结果支持"无对称性保护时低温相与高温相仍由热相变分隔"的猜想。
AI.motivation: 传统有限温度相通过自发对称破缺来研究，但对称破缺场（如 Ising 模型）可能消除相的区别，因此需要寻找不依赖对称性保护的稳定非平凡热相，即检验低/高温相是否能在无对称保护下依然区分。
AI.method: 对定义在 m 维胞腔自旋上的经典 Z₂ 格点规范模型作严格解析：在足够低的有限正温度与足够弱局域扰动下，证明热力学自由能密度在温度与扰动强度上联合解析（扰动可破坏内部/规范对称，可含非对易量子相互作用）；再通过独立的高温展开给出解析区域，该区域在任意固定有限扰动强度下延伸至无穷温度。
AI.result: 低温柔性：自由能密度在温度与扰动强度上联合解析（条件 1 ≤ m ≤ d-2）；高温侧：解析区域在任意固定有限扰动强度下可达无穷温度。由此确立热力学稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 在无对称性保护的情形下，低温和高温解析区域依然存在，支持"二者之间由热相变分隔"的猜想；为不依赖对称性保护的非平凡热相研究提供严格基础。

title: Rare-earth tuning of magnetic entropy and interaction scales in K$_3$$Ln$(PO$_4$)$_2$ ($Ln$ = Yb, Gd) for adiabatic demagnetization refrigeration
summary: Adiabatic demagnetization refrigeration (ADR) based on frustrated rare-earth magnets provides a promising route toward helium-free sub-Kelvin cooling, while balancing magnetic entropy and interaction scales is essential for optimizing the ADR functionalities. Here we investigate the low-temperature magnetic and ADR properties of the alkali rare-earth double phosphates K$_3$$Ln$(PO$_4$)$_2$ ($Ln$ = Yb, Gd), which crystallize in a monoclinic $P2_1/m$ structure containing distorted isosceles triangular lattices of rare-earth ions. Magnetization and specific heat measurements confirm the absence of long-range magnetic ordering down to 0.1 K in both compounds. Direct quasi-ADR measurements demonstrate strongly contrasting refrigeration behaviors: K$_3$Yb(PO$_4$)$_2$ reaches a minimum temperature of 29.8 mK from an initial state of 2 K and 6 T, whereas K$_3$Gd(PO$_4$)$_2$ exhibits extended hold times below 150 mK associated with its larger magnetic entropy reservoir. Crystal-electric-field calculations confirm a $J_{\mathrm{eff}} = 1/2$ ground-state doublet in K$_3$Yb(PO$_4$)$_2$, while thermodynamic analysis based on magnetic entropy and interaction scales accounts for the distinct ADR performance of the two compounds. These results identify K$_3$$Ln$(PO$_4$)$_2$ as a chemically robust platform for rare-earth-tunable solid-state ADR.

AI.tldr: 研究K3Ln(PO4)2 (Ln=Yb, Gd)阻挫稀土磁体的低温磁性与绝热去磁制冷性能，两种化合物呈现互补的ADR行为。
AI.motivation: 基于阻挫稀土磁体的绝热去磁制冷(ADR)是实现无氦亚开尔文制冷的路径，但需平衡磁熵与相互作用尺度以优化ADR功能。
AI.method: 合成单斜P2_1/m结构、含畸变等腰三角格子的K3Ln(PO4)2 (Ln=Yb,Gd)，进行磁化与比热测量(低至0.1 K)、直接准ADR测量，并结合晶体电场计算与磁熵/相互作用尺度热力学分析。
AI.result: 两化合物低至0.1 K均无长程磁有序；K3Yb(PO4)2从2 K、6 T初态降至最低29.8 mK，而K3Gd(PO4)2因更大磁熵库在150 mK以下保持更长时间；晶体电场计算确认K3Yb(PO4)2具有J_eff=1/2基态双重态。
AI.conclusion: K3Ln(PO4)2是化学稳定、稀土可调的固态ADR平台，磁熵与相互作用尺度的平衡解释了两种化合物的不同制冷表现。

title: Contrasting Crystal-Field and Dipolar Anisotropies in the Triangular Antiferromagnet NaBaEr(BO$_3$)$_2$
summary: The magnetic ground states of rare-earth frustrated magnets can be governed by competing energy scales arising from crystal-field anisotropy, exchange interactions, and long-range dipolar interactions. Here we investigate this interplay in the triangular-lattice antiferromagnet NaBaEr(BO$_3$)$_2$ by combining magnetization, specific heat, and neutron scattering measurements. Neutron powder diffraction resolves rotations of the ErO$_6$ octahedra and supports the lower-symmetry $R\bar{3}$ structure over the previously proposed $R\bar{3}m$ model. Magnetization measurements and inelastic neutron scattering establish an effective spin-1/2 description of its low-temperature magnetism with pronounced easy-axis anisotropy, arising from a well-isolated Kramers ground-state doublet separated from the first excited crystal-electric-field level by approximately 4 meV. Below $T_{\rm N}=0.1$ K, single-crystal neutron diffraction reveals A-type antiferromagnetic order with the ordered moment predominantly oriented within the $ab$ plane, despite the pronounced paramagnetic easy-axis anisotropy. The estimated dipolar interaction scale is comparable to $T_{\rm N}$, and classical dipolar-energy calculations for the observed stacking pattern favor an in-plane moment orientation. These results reveal contrasting crystal-field and dipolar anisotropies in determining the magnetic ground state of NaBaEr(BO$_3$)$_2$.

AI.tldr: 本文通过磁化率、比热和中子散射研究了三角晶格反铁磁体NaBaEr(BO3)2中晶体场各向异性、交换作用和偶极相互作用竞争下的磁基态，发现其低温呈有效自旋1/2、强易轴各向异性，并在T_N=0.1 K以下形成磁矩主要位于ab面的A型反铁磁序。
AI.motivation: 稀土阻挫磁体的磁基态由晶体场各向异性、交换作用与长程偶极相互作用等多个能量尺度竞争决定，理清这些相互作用如何共同塑造基态是理解该类材料的关键。
AI.method: 结合磁化率测量、比热测量与中子散射（中子粉末衍射、非弹性中子散射、单晶中子衍射），并辅以经典偶极能计算。
AI.result: 中子粉末衍射解析出ErO6八面体旋转，支持低对称性R-3结构而非先前提出的R-3m；确认Kramers基态二重态与第一激发晶体场能级间隔约4 meV，形成有效自旋1/2及显著易轴各向异性；在T_N=0.1 K以下观察到A型反铁磁序，有序磁矩主要位于ab面，与顺磁易轴各向异性相反；偶极相互作用尺度与T_N相当，偶极能计算支持面内磁矩取向。
AI.conclusion: NaBaEr(BO3)2的磁基态由晶体场各向异性与偶极各向异性之间的对立共同决定，二者对磁矩取向给出相反偏好，凸显了多能量尺度竞争在稀土阻挫磁体中的重要作用。

title: Polarity-selective domain wall propagation driven by spin-orbit torque
summary: Spatial variations in magnetic anisotropy impede the spin-orbit-torque-driven motion of chiral domain walls in perpendicularly magnetized nanowires. We show that the local geometry of a two-dimensional anisotropy landscape can select which wall polarity propagates under a given current. Micromagnetic simulations of spatially correlated random anisotropy landscapes generated by diffusion-based smoothing reveal different propagation outcomes for up--down and down--up walls within the same disorder realization. A single inclined anisotropy boundary isolates the mechanism: in the presence of the Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interaction, opposite wall polarities develop opposite current-induced tilts, producing different alignment with the boundary and hence different pinning strengths. Reversing the boundary inclination interchanges the pinned and propagating polarities. An extended collective-coordinate model captures this geometric selection and distinguishes the propagation threshold from the static pinning limit.

AI.tldr: 空间变化的磁各向异性会阻碍手性畴壁在自旋轨道矩驱动下的运动；二维各向异性"地形"的局部几何可选择性决定哪种畴壁极性在给定电流下传播。
AI.motivation: 理解垂直磁化纳米线中各向异性无序如何影响手性畴壁的传播，特别是为何同一无序实现的up-down与down-up畴壁传播行为不同，其物理机制尚不明确。
AI.method: 结合微磁模拟（对扩散平滑生成的空间相关随机各向异性场进行模拟）与扩展的集体坐标模型；并构造单个倾斜各向异性边界作为隔离机制的最小模型，分析DMI诱导的相反畴壁倾斜与边界的对齐关系。
AI.result: 同一无序实现中两种畴壁极性传播结果不同；倾斜边界下，DMI使相反极性产生相反的电流诱导倾斜，导致不同的钉扎强度；反转边界倾斜方向会交换被钉扎与可传播的极性；集体坐标模型成功再现该几何选择并区分传播阈值与静态钉扎极限。
AI.conclusion: 各向异性景观的局部几何是选择畴壁传播极性的关键机制，为无序磁纳米线中畴壁动力学的确定性控制提供几何设计思路。

title: Time-Reversal Symmetry in Artificial Topological Graphene Rings
summary: We study an artificial graphene ring described by the low-energy two-valley Dirac Hamiltonian with a uniform mass term. When the ring is threaded by an Aharonov-Bohm flux, the problem reduces to a second-order radial equation solved by Bessel functions. We give the exact secular equation and, for narrow rings, closed expressions for the spectrum and the persistent current. We then add a uniform magnetic field perpendicular to the plane. The radial problem is solved with confluent hypergeometric functions, and the persistent current and magnetization are written as derivatives of a secular determinant from which the spurious roots have been removed. Besides the usual orbital coupling, the field enters through a valley-dependent term that comes from the Dirac structure and lifts the valley degeneracy. A weak-field expansion, accurate up to corrections of order B^4, gives this valley splitting explicitly and separates the diamagnetic and paramagnetic contributions to the susceptibility. Finally, we work out what time reversal implies for the spectrum. Physical time reversal, which exchanges the valleys, leads to an exact relation between levels at opposite fields. The effective single-valley time reversal, on the other hand, is broken by the mass term and by the boundary conditions, yet leaves no trace in the zero-field spectrum. Numerical results for the spectrum, the persistent current, and the magnetization illustrate the analysis.

AI.tldr: 研究石墨烯量子环在Aharonov-Bohm磁通和垂直均匀磁场下的能谱、持续电流与磁化，给出解析久期方程、弱场展开及时间反演对称性分析。
AI.motivation: 石墨烯环兼具Dirac锥、谷自由度与量子相位效应，需要精确解析框架统一描述AB通量与均匀磁场下的能谱、持续电流、磁化及谷简并破缺，并澄清物理/有效时间反演的作用。
AI.method: 采用低能两谷Dirac哈密顿量加均匀质量项；AB通量下约化为Bessel函数求解的二阶径向方程并给出久期方程；加垂直磁场后用合流超几何函数求解，把持续电流与磁化写成去除伪根后的久期行列式的导数；再做至B^4精度的弱场展开。
AI.result: 获得精确久期方程与窄环闭式谱和持续电流；磁场除轨道耦合外还通过谷依赖项解除谷简并，弱场展开显式给出谷劈裂并分离抗磁/顺磁磁化率贡献；物理时间反演给出相反磁场下能级的精确关系。
AI.conclusion: 建立了石墨烯环磁响应的精确解析框架，数值结果验证分析；有效单谷时间反演被质量项和边界条件破坏但在零场谱中无痕。

title: Adiabatic confinement and number-theoretic spectra of massless Dirac fermions in twisted trilayer graphene
summary: Electrons in graphene move like massless relativistic particles, making them exceptionally mobile but difficult to trap because Klein tunnelling permits unimpeded passage through electrostatic barriers. This challenge extends to atomic collapse and hadron confinement. Twisted trilayers form Bernal and rhombohedral domains joined by smooth boundaries, bringing their carriers into contact. Here we show that a new mechanism, distinct from established approaches, confines massless fermions in equilateral triangular Bernal domains without mass barriers, bulk gaps or physical edges. Simulations and analytical modeling reveal that massless carriers have no adiabatic continuation into rhombohedral domains, while escape through nonadiabatic coupling to massive carriers is exponentially suppressed by smooth stacking variation. Perfect reflection in the adiabatic limit turns Bernal domains into quantum cavities in a gapless, edgeless metal. Striking density-of-states oscillations encode Eisenstein-integer arithmetic, linking energies and degeneracies to norms and prime factorizations. These findings bring relativistic confinement and number theory into experimentally accessible electronic spectra.

AI.tldr: 扭曲三层石墨烯中,无质量费米子因缺乏绝热延拓且非绝热耦合被指数抑制,被束缚在三角形Bernal畴内形成无隙、无边缘的量子腔,其态密度振荡编码Eisenstein整数算术。
AI.motivation: 石墨烯中电子类似无质量相对论粒子,迁移率极高,但因Klein隧穿可无阻碍穿过静电势垒而难以束缚;这一问题也延伸到原子坍缩和强子禁闭。作者希望找到一种与现有方法不同的新机制来束缚无质量费米子,且不需要质量势垒、体能隙或物理边缘。
AI.method: 利用扭曲三层石墨烯,其中Bernal与菱方畴通过平滑边界相连、载流子相互接触。通过数值模拟与解析建模,分析无质量载流子在Bernal畴与菱方畴之间的绝热延拓性及非绝热耦合行为。可视为理论/数值结合的分析方法。
AI.result: 发现无质量载流子无法绝热延拓进入菱方畴;通过非绝热耦合逃逸到有质量载流子的过程随堆叠平滑变化而被指数抑制。在绝热极限下Bernal畴内实现完美反射,形成无隙、无边缘金属中的量子腔。态密度振荡呈现Eisenstein整数算术特征,将能量与简并度同范数及素因数分解联系起来。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出一种全新的相对论性束缚机制,无需质量势垒、体能隙或物理边缘即可将无质量费米子束缚于三角形Bernal畴中,并把相对论禁闭与数论引入实验可及的电子能谱,为研究原子坍缩、强子禁闭等问题提供可探测平台。

title: Neural Network Fractional Quantum Hall States with Learnable Orbital Pair Matrix Factors: Balancing Physical Priors and Flexibility
summary: Neural network fractional quantum Hall (FQH) states offer a promising alternative for capturing Landau level (LL) mixing and for understanding FQH physics, yet the incorporation of physical priors has so far been limited to the minimal exact constraints built into the ansatz. Working in spherical geometry, we show that the network's flexibility suffers both when only minimal additional physical priors are supplied and when priors such as flux attachment are imposed rigidly. In the former case, the monopole harmonic product orbital (MHPO) ansatz is difficult to optimize, whereas in the latter, the expressivity of the neural network is restricted. We therefore propose the orbital pair matrix factor MHPO (MHPO-M) ansatz, which balances physical priors against flexibility by not only replacing the fixed Laughlin structure with learnable pair factors but also making them dependent on both the electron configurations and the orbitals. Across $ν=1/5$, $1/3$, and $2/5$, MHPO-M achieves the lowest variational energy among the tested variants, and a factorized orbital readout based on it enables scaling to 35 electrons, with energies competitive with trends inferred from three-LL exact-diagonalization results. These results demonstrate that physical priors can be appropriately incorporated without sacrificing the flexibility of neural network wavefunctions, opening a promising path toward accurate, scalable modeling of FQH systems with LL mixing.

AI.tldr: 提出轨道对矩阵因子MHPO（MHPO-M）ansatz，在物理先验与神经网络灵活性之间取得平衡，在ν=1/5、1/3、2/5取得最低变分能量，并可扩展至35个电子。
AI.motivation: 神经网络分数量子霍尔态虽能刻画朗道能级混合，但物理先验的引入目前仅限于ansatz内置的最小精确约束。作者发现：仅提供少量额外先验时（MHPO）难以优化，而刚性施加通量附着（Laughlin）先验又会限制网络表达力，因此需要一种兼顾先验与灵活性的方案。
AI.method: 在球面几何下，用可学习的电子对因子替换MHPO中固定的Laughlin结构，并使因子同时依赖于电子构型和轨道，构造MHPO-M ansatz（轨道对矩阵因子MHPO）；并设计基于该ansatz的因子化轨道读出，以实现大体系缩放。
AI.result: 在ν=1/5、1/3、2/5下，MHPO-M在所测变体中获得最低变分能量；因子化轨道读出使其可扩展到35个电子，能量与三层朗道能级精确对角化结果推断的趋势具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 物理先验可在不牺牲神经网络波函数灵活性的前提下被恰当引入，为含朗道能级混合的FQH体系提供准确、可扩展的建模路径。

title: Field theories and critical excitations at anyon condensation transitions
summary: Anyon condensation transitions remain challenging to characterize especially when the condensing anyons are non-abelian. We develop two complementary approaches for extracting information about the transition from the categorical data of the parent topological order and the condensate. The first adapts a Ginzburg-Landau procedure developed for $1+1$D transitions in the SymTFT setting to $2+1$D anyon condensation transitions. The construction applies when the anyons participating in the condensate have integer quantum dimensions. The second gives a criterion for identifying which point and loop excitations become critical at a continuous transition. The key step is to determine which anyon loops remain condensed throughout. All other loops become critical, while a point excitation becomes critical if it braids trivially with every condensed loop. We illustrate both proposals in several abelian and non-abelian examples.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种从父拓扑序与凝聚体的范畴数据中提取任意子凝聚相变信息的方法：一是将1+1维SymTFT的Ginzburg-Landau方法推广到2+1维任意子凝聚（适用于量子维数为整数的任意子）；二是给出判定哪些点/圈激发在连续相变处变为临界的判据，核心是确定哪些任意子圈始终保持凝聚，其余圈变为临界，而点激发若与所有凝聚圈平凡编织则也变临界。
AI.motivation: 任意子凝聚相变难以刻画，尤其当凝聚的任意子为非阿贝尔时，缺乏系统工具从范畴数据中提取相变信息。
AI.method: 方法一：将原本用于1+1维相变的SymTFT Ginzburg-Landau流程推广到2+1维任意子凝聚，要求参与凝聚的任意子量子维数为整数。方法二：通过判定在整个相变过程中保持凝聚的任意子圈，给出识别临界点激发与圈激发的判据——非保持凝聚的圈均变为临界，点激发则需与所有凝聚圈平凡编织才变临界。
AI.result: 两种方案在多个阿贝尔与非阿贝尔例子中得到验证，能够从范畴数据中一致地识别相变处的临界激发与凝聚结构。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为（含非阿贝尔）任意子凝聚相变提供了互补的范畴层面分析框架，有助于刻画临界行为与凝聚模式。

title: Enhancement of Li and Na Storage in Janus HfSSe Monolayers by Co-Induced Electron-Deficient Chalcogen Sites: A First-Principles Study
summary: The growing demand for high-capacity, fast-charging, and durable rechargeable batteries has intensified the search for advanced electrode materials, with two-dimensional materials offering large surface-to-mass ratios and short ion-diffusion pathways. Here, pristine and Co-doped Janus HfSSe monolayers were investigated as anode materials for Li-ion and Na-ion batteries using first-principles density functional theory. Pristine HfSSe was found to be dynamically stable and exhibited a 0.85 eV band gap, while Co substitution shifted the Fermi level toward the valence-band region. Adsorption of the first Li or Na layer induced metallic behavior, thereby improving charge transport. Co doping strengthened alkali-metal binding, with the most favorable Li and Na adsorption energies changing from -2.6125 and -1.9800 eV to -3.7405 and -3.0529 eV, respectively. Co doping created electron-deficient sites that enhanced Li/Na binding. Co-doped HfSSe accommodated up to four Li layers and three Na layers, increasing the theoretical capacities from 555.43 to 776.19 mAh/g for Li and from 370.29 to 582.14 mAh/g for Na. The average open-circuit voltages were 0.62 V for Li and 0.29-0.30 V for Na, with minimum migration barriers of 0.2153 and 0.1044 eV, respectively. These results identified Co-doped Janus HfSSe as a promising anode material for Li-ion and Na-ion batteries.

AI.tldr: 本文用第一性原理DFT研究了原始与Co掺杂Janus HfSSe单层作为Li/Na离子电池负极材料，Co掺杂增强了碱金属吸附、提升了理论容量（Li 555→776 mAh/g，Na 370→582 mAh/g）并保持低迁移势垒，为有前景的负极候选材料。
AI.motivation: 高容量、快充、耐久电池需求增长，亟需先进电极材料；二维材料具有大比表面积和短离子扩散路径，Janus HfSSe的储锂/储钠潜力及掺杂调控尚未充分研究。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT），系统计算原始与Co掺杂Janus HfSSe单层的动力学稳定性、电子结构（带隙、费米能级）、Li/Na吸附能与多层吸附、理论容量、开路电压及离子迁移势垒。
AI.result: 原始HfSSe动力学稳定、带隙0.85 eV；Co掺杂使费米能级移向价带；首层Li/Na吸附后呈金属性；Co掺杂使最优Li/Na吸附能由-2.6125/-1.9800 eV增至-3.7405/-3.0529 eV；Co掺杂可容纳4层Li、3层Na，容量由555.43提升至776.19 mAh/g（Li）、由370.29提升至582.14 mAh/g（Na）；平均开路电压Li为0.62 V、Na为0.29–0.30 V；最小迁移势垒分别为0.2153 eV和0.1044 eV。
AI.conclusion: Co掺杂Janus HfSSe单层具备增强的吸附、高理论容量、合适电压和低扩散势垒，是有前景的Li/Na离子电池负极材料。

title: Density Saturation and Autocorrelation Characteristics of Interlayer Exciton Ensembles in MoSe$_2$/WSe$_2$ Heterostructures
summary: We investigate interlayer excitons in MoSe$_2$/WSe$_2$ heterostructures using time-resolved photoluminescence and second-order autocorrelation measurements across a wide range of excitation powers and bath temperatures. By analyzing the photoluminescence amplitude and lifetime of the interlayer exciton state with the lowest emission energy, we extract a corresponding density-temperature diagram. The extracted exciton density exhibits a saturation at approximately $10^{13}$cm$^{-2}$, consistent with values predicted for a Mott transition of interlayer exciton ensembles in van der Waals heterostructures. Moreover, possible interpretations beyond the Mott transition are discussed. We further test whether the density limit is accompanied by a departure from classical photon statistics. The second-order autocorrelation measurements reveal that the photoluminescence maintains an emission characteristic of $g^{(2)}(0) \approx 1$ from low exciton densities up to the maximum reachable density in the investigated exciton ensembles consistent with the lowest-energy exciton ensemble obeying Poissonian statistics.

AI.tldr: 研究MoSe₂/WSe₂异质结层间激子，通过功率和温度扫描发现激子密度在~10¹³cm⁻²处饱和，且g⁽²⁾(0)≈1保持泊松统计。
AI.motivation: 探究范德华异质结中层间激子的密度上限（是否对应莫特转变），并检验高密度下是否偏离经典光子统计。
AI.method: 对MoSe₂/WSe₂异质结做时间分辨光致发光与二阶自相关测量，在大范围激发功率和热浴温度下，用最低发射能级层间激子的PL幅度和寿命提取密度-温度图。
AI.result: 激子密度在约10¹³cm⁻²处饱和，与预测的层间激子莫特转变值一致；g⁽²⁾(0)从低密度到最大可达密度均约等于1，符合泊松统计。
AI.conclusion: 观察到的密度饱和可能与莫特转变一致，但也存在其他解释；在所研究密度范围内未出现亚泊松光子统计的偏离。

title: Crucial role of magnetic dipole and anomalous field dependence in $\mathrm{NiPS_3}$
summary: $\mathrm{NiPS_3}$ has attracted considerable attention, yet the origin of its intriguing magnetic behaviors remains elusive due to limited insight into its low-energy anisotropy. Here, high-field torque magnetometry measurements are performed, revealing a previously unrecognized anisotropic spin response that reflects interaction terms beyond the standard XY or XXZ models. In combination with relativistic density functional theory calculations and magnetic force response theory, an effective low-energy spin Hamiltonian is constructed, elucidating not only the observed anomalous magnetic behavior but also other recent experiments. Remarkably, the magnetic dipole interaction and the associated spin-flop transition play a crucial role in driving the deviation from two-dimensional spin alignment, providing direct insight into the underlying anisotropic energy hierarchy. The generalized Hamiltonian can serve as the important fundamental ground for future study, and our approach adopted here will hopefully be relevant to many other related material systems.

AI.tldr: 通过高场转矩磁测量、相对论DFT与磁力响应理论构建NiPS3的有效低能自旋哈密顿量，揭示其磁各向异性来源。
AI.motivation: NiPS3的磁性行为引人关注，但其低能各向异性认识不足，导致磁性起源不明。
AI.method: 高场转矩磁测量，结合相对论密度泛函理论计算与磁力响应理论，构建有效低能自旋哈密顿量。
AI.result: 发现超出标准XY/XXZ模型的各向异性自旋响应；磁偶极相互作用及伴随的自旋翻转转变驱动偏离二维自旋排列，解释异常磁性及近期实验。
AI.conclusion: 给出各向异性能量层级的直接认识，广义哈密顿量为后续研究奠定基础，方法可推广至相关材料体系。

title: High-throughput Down-selection of Fusion Candidate Materials
summary: Developing radiation-resistant fusion reactor materials is constrained by the slow pace of conventional irradiation qualification methodologies, which usually require extensive one-at-a-time irradiation campaigns and post-irradiation characterization. At the current pace of development, we may not discover the materials necessary to deploy fusion power plants at desired rates. In this work, we present a high-throughput (HT) experimental framework for the accelerated down-selection of fusion-relevant, Cu-Cr-Ta RF antenna materials by integrating combinatorial synthesis, in situ ion irradiation, and multi-property screening within a unified workflow. A 2D compositional Cu-Cr-Ta gradient wafer was fabricated by physical vapor deposition and characterized using in situ ion irradiation transient grating spectroscopy I3TGS. Radiation-induced surface acoustic wave frequency fluctuations were used as a rapid proxy for primary defect accumulation, while thermal diffusivity measurements were obtained simultaneously during irradiation. Complementary HT characterization included EDS compositional mapping, four-point probe electrical resistivity measurements, and waste disposal rating calculations to evaluate long-term activation behavior. This integrated methodology enabled an acceleration with respect to conventional irradiation approaches by more than 100 times, from months to hours to analyze 78 new materials.

AI.tldr: 提出集成组合合成、原位离子辐照与多性能筛选的高通量实验框架，将Cu-Cr-Ta射频天线材料的辐照筛选速度提升100倍以上。
AI.motivation: 传统辐照鉴定方法需逐一进行辐照实验和辐照后表征，速度极慢，难以按需速度发现聚变堆所需抗辐照材料。
AI.method: 用物理气相沉积制备二维Cu-Cr-Ta成分梯度晶圆，采用原位离子辐照瞬态光栅光谱（I³TGS）以表面声波频率波动作为初级缺陷积累的快速指标，同时测量热扩散率；辅以EDS成分映射、四探针电阻率和废物处置评级计算。
AI.result: 在数小时内分析了78种新材料，相比传统方法（数月）加速超过100倍。
AI.conclusion: 该一体化高通量工作流可显著加速聚变相关材料的辐照筛选与初步优选。

title: Saturating $T^2$ resistivity in iron-based superconductors
summary: Many correlated metals exhibit a crossover from low-temperature $ρ\propto T^{2}$ behavior to a slower increase of the resistivity at elevated temperatures. Distinguishing phonon scattering from electron--electron correlations as the origin of this crossover is experimentally challenging. We introduce a simple phenomenological framework that isolates the contribution responsible for the high-temperature saturating tendency. This approach reveals a clear contrast between systems well known for the predominance of electron--phonon scattering and several iron-based superconductors. For the latter, the conductivity can be expressed as the sum of a Fermi-liquid-like term ($\propto 1/T^{2}$) and a temperature-independent component, which together describe $ρ(T)$ up to $\sim 250$ K in LiFeAs, KFe$_2$As$_2$, and KCaFe$_4$As$_4$. In FeSe, the same approach identifies a similar regime above the nematic transition, with a pronounced change toward nearly linear-in-$T$ resistivity below it. We discuss these findings in the broader context of coherence and electronic correlations in Hund's metals.

AI.tldr: 提出一种简单唯象框架，用于区分相关金属中高温电阻率饱和行为的来源（声子散射 vs 电子-电子关联），发现铁基超导体电阻率可分解为类费米液体项(∝1/T²)与温度无关项之和。
AI.motivation: 许多相关金属中电阻率从低温ρ∝T²过渡到高温下较慢的增长，但实验上难以区分该转变源于声子散射还是电子-电子关联。
AI.method: 引入一个简单的唯象框架，分离出导致高温饱和趋势的贡献，并与已知以电子-声子散射为主的体系进行对比。
AI.result: 在LiFeAs、KFe₂As₂和KCaFe₄As₄中，电导率可表示为类费米液体项(∝1/T²)与温度无关项之和，可描述约250 K以下的ρ(T)；FeSe在向列相变以上呈现类似区间，而在其下方电阻率显著转为近线性温度依赖。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能有效区分散射来源，并在Hund金属的相干性与电子关联背景下对上述铁基超导体结果进行了讨论。

title: Proliferation Transitions for Quantum Doubles of Groups
summary: Proliferation transitions are phase transitions between a 2+1d topological order $\mathcal{T}$ and another $\mathcal{T}/\mathcal{A}$, obtained by condensing anyons in an algebra $\mathcal{A}\subset \mathcal{T}$. We consider such transitions in quantum doubles of groups, $\mathcal{T}=D(G, ω)$, for finite groups $G$ possibly with three-cocycle $ω$, for which condensable algebras are fully classified. Given a condensable algebra $\mathcal{A}$, we represent $\mathcal{T}$ in terms of a Symmetry Topological Field Theory (SymTFT), that is tailored to the $\mathcal{A}$ proliferation transition. The SymTFT bulk is constructed from the Müger center of the subcategory generated by the algebra, i.e. the category of transparent lines, which can be bosons or fermions. Properties of the transition can then be inferred directly from the algebra classification data. For gauged Landau-Ginzburg (LG*) type transitions, we show that they do not only depend on the anyons in $\mathcal{A}$ through their field content, but the cubic interactions are fixed in terms of the multiplication structure of $\mathcal{A}$. Applied to twin algebras, which have the same anyon content but different multiplication structures, we show that twins result in distinct proliferation transitions.

AI.tldr: 该文研究量子二重群 $D(G,\omega)$ 中的增殖相变，用适配该相变的对称性拓扑场论(SymTFT)刻画相变，证明相变性质可由凝聚代数分类数据直接推断，并指出LG*型相变中三次相互作用由代数的乘法结构决定，双胞胎代数给出不同相变。
AI.motivation: 增殖相变是 $2+1$ 维拓扑序 $\mathcal{T}$ 与 $\mathcal{T}/\mathcal{A}$ 之间的相变，凝聚代数 $\mathcal{A}$ 的完整分类在有限群量子二重群中已知，但如何从代数数据直接读出相变性质（尤其是规范化 Landau-Ginzburg 型相变）尚不清楚，且同一能标内容但乘法结构不同的代数（双胞胎）是否导致不同相变需要澄清。
AI.method: 对给定凝聚代数 $\mathcal{A}$，用对称性拓扑场论(SymTFT)表示 $\mathcal{T}$：SymTFT 体由代数生成子范畴的 Müger 中心（透明线构成的范畴，可为玻色子或费米子）构造，从而相变性质可由代数分类数据直接推断。
AI.result: 对 gauged Landau-Ginzburg (LG*) 型相变，相变不仅依赖 $\mathcal{A}$ 中任意子的场内容，三次相互作用还由 $\mathcal{A}$ 的乘法结构固定；对具有相同任意子内容但乘法结构不同的 twin 代数，其增殖相变彼此不同。
AI.conclusion: SymTFT 构造提供了从凝聚代数数据提取增殖相变性质的统一框架；LG* 型相变的三次相互作用由代数乘法结构决定，因此仅凭任意子内容不足以确定相变，双胞胎代数目确实产生不同的增殖相变。

title: Classical spin liquids in the kagome Ising model, and their link with magnetoelasticity
summary: We investigate a nearest-neighbor Ising model on the kagome lattice coupled to elastic lattice distortions. By integrating out the lattice degrees of freedom, we derive an approximate spin-only description in terms of a kagome \(J_1\)-\(J_2\)-\(J_{3}\) Ising model with interactions extending to third nearest-neighbors. Using tensor network methods complemented by classical Monte Carlo simulations, we revisit its zero-temperature phase diagram and characterize the ground states studied more than thirty years ago. We discover three phases with extensive zero-temperature entropy and algebraically decaying spin correlations. Importantly, these states are not confined to fine-tuned points or frontiers between phases, but occupy extended areas of parameter space. Their quasi long-range order is reflected in Bragg-like peaks in the structure factors; we relate this, and other properties, to diverse phases found in Ising and Heisenberg models. Finally, we trace the trajectories generated by the magnetoelastic coupling through the effective-model phase diagram, explaining the emergence of self-frustration for the unfrustrated magnetoelastic model with ferromagnetic interactions.

AI.tldr: 将kagome晶格Ising磁体与弹性晶格畸变耦合后，约化为J1-J2-J3 Ising模型，用张量网络和经典Monte Carlo重访其零温相图，发现三个占据参数空间有限区域、具有广延零温熵与代数衰减关联的相，并追踪磁弹耦合轨迹、解释未受挫铁磁模型的自受挫现象。
AI.motivation: kagome Ising反铁磁体的基态相图三十年前已有研究，但当时结果有限；本文希望通过引入磁弹耦合把晶格自由度精确积掉，得到一个只在自旋上的有效模型，从而系统重访该零温相图，并理解自受挫（self-frustration）及准长程序如何产生。
AI.method: 对耦合弹性畸变的kagome最近邻Ising模型，积掉晶格自由度，得到含至第三近邻相互作用的kagome J1-J2-J3 Ising有效模型；用张量网络方法（如CTMRG/PEPS类）结合经典Monte Carlo计算零温相图、基态熵、自旋关联与结构因子。
AI.result: 在零温相图中发现三个具有广延零温熵和代数衰减自旋关联的相；这些相不是孤立点或相边界，而是占据参数空间的扩展区域；其准长程序表现为结构因子中的类Bragg峰；并将这些相与其他Ising、Heisenberg模型中的相联系起来。此外，追踪磁弹耦合在有效相图中的轨迹，解释了未受挫铁磁磁弹模型中自受挫的出现。
AI.conclusion: kagome J1-J2-J3 Ising模型具有稳定的、占据有限参数区域的代数有序相，而非仅限精调点；磁弹耦合自然地把系统驱动进这些区域，从而在本来未受挫的铁磁系统中产生自受挫，为理解kagome磁体的有限温行为与自受挫机制提供了统一图像。

title: Steady-state cooperative emission of interlayer excitons in atomically thin light-emitting diodes
summary: When an ensemble of emitters is confined within an optical wavelength, its radiation can become correlated, leading to cooperative emission. In two-dimensional (2D) transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) electron-hole bilayers, strong light-matter coupling enables the formation of interlayer excitons (IXs), long-lived dipolar excitations that provide an ideal setting for emergent collective phenomena. Here, we engineer an atomically thin light-emitting diode (LED) that generates electroluminescence (EL) from electrically injected IXs that are confined near the sample edges by an edge-enhanced fringing electric field. By measuring Hanbury-Brown-Twiss photon-photon correlations, we find pronounced signatures of collective decay in the form of large photon bunching followed by finite delay antibunching and bunching revivals. These emitter correlation signatures disappear when free charge carriers are doped to form a degenerate Fermi sea but are enhanced by the introduction of localized electrons. The results are consistent with a many-body quantum master equation that models the steady-state superradiant photon statistics of incoherently injected IXs. Our work establishes steady-state cooperative emission in a 2D TMD LED as a platform for studying strong light-matter interactions in electrically driven, non-equilibrium phases of Bose-Fermi mixtures.

AI.tldr: 该工作构建了原子级薄的TMD双层LED，利用边缘增强的 fringe 电场将电注入的层间激子（IX）局域在样品边缘，并通过HBT光子相关测量观测到稳态协同辐射（superradiance）特征。
AI.motivation: 当多个发射体被限制在光波长内时，其辐射可相互关联并产生协同发射。二维TMD电子-空穴双层中强光-物质耦合可形成长寿命偶极型层间激子，是研究涌现集体现象的理想平台；但如何通过电驱动、在非平衡稳态下实现并探测这种协同发射仍具挑战。
AI.method: 设计原子级薄TMD双层LED，通过边缘增强的 fringe 电场将电注入的IX局域在样品边缘；测量Hanbury-Brown-Twiss光子-光子相关，观察光子聚束、有限延迟反聚束及聚束复兴；对比自由载流子掺杂形成简并费米海与引入局域电子两种情形；并用多体量子主方程建模非相干注入IX的稳态超辐射光子统计。
AI.result: 观察到显著的集体衰减特征：大的光子聚束、随后有限延迟的反聚束及聚束复兴。这些发射体关联信号在掺杂自由载流子形成简并费米海时消失，而在引入局域电子时增强，与多体量子主方程对非相干注入IX稳态超辐射光子统计的预测一致。
AI.conclusion: 该研究确立了二维TMD LED中的稳态协同发射，可作为研究电驱动、非平衡玻色-费米混合相中强光-物质相互作用的平台。

title: Electronic driving of torsional modes in carbon nanotubes via orbital-phonon coupling
summary: We theoretically investigate electronic driving of a torsional mode in a suspended carbon nanotube quantum dot. The valley states in a nanotube carry opposite orbital magnetic moments along the tube axis, and intervalley mixing forms valley-mixed eigenstates whose splitting can be controlled by an axial magnetic field. We formulate an orbital-rotation coupling between the torsional angular velocity and the valley orbital angular momentum. Using a master equation for sequential tunneling through normal-metal electrodes, we calculate the steady-state current and the phonon distribution of the torsional mode. When the valley-state splitting matches the torsional phonon energy, orbital transitions can drive the mode out of equilibrium. The contacts control both phonon pumping and its electrical readout, allowing substantial excitation with a positive, vanishing, or negative current response. The mechanism requires no intrinsic spin or valley polarization of the electrodes, but uses state-dependent tunneling at the contacts.

AI.tldr: 本文理论研究了悬浮碳纳米管量子点中扭转模式的电子驱动：谷态携带反向轨道磁矩，轴向磁场调控谷混合态劈裂，通过"轨道旋转耦合"实现谷轨道角动量与扭转角速度的耦合，可在序贯隧穿下泵浦扭转声子并由电流读出。
AI.motivation: 探索无需电极自旋或谷极化的条件下，如何用电流驱动纳米机械扭转模式，并实现电学读出。
AI.method: 建立扭转角速度与谷轨道角动量的轨道旋转耦合；用电极序贯隧穿的主方程计算稳态电流与扭转模式的声子分布。
AI.result: 当谷态劈裂与扭转声子能量共振时，轨道跃迁可将模式驱动至非平衡态；接触可同时控制声子泵浦与电学读出，表现为正、零或负的电流响应，可实现显著激发。
AI.conclusion: 碳纳米管量子点中谷轨道自由度为扭转模式的电驱动与探测提供了新途径，且不依赖电极的内禀极化。

title: Spin-wave circulation in unbounded ferromagnetic film
summary: A key challenge in spin-wave computing is steering spin waves through circuits without wave distortion or reflections. This often results in 1D propagation scenarios, which hinder applicability in 2D magnonic circuits. We demonstrate experimentally a novel approach using a hard magnetic spherical microparticle to guide spin-waves onto a closed path in a plain thin YIG film. The particle stray field induces a radially symmetrical magnetization landscape, which allows spin-waves to loop around. In parallel, we conducted micromagnetic simulations reproducing the experimental conditions, which confirm the circulation of spin-waves over several loops around the particle. This work demonstrates the possibility to steer spin-waves onto a circular path using inhomogeneous magnetic landscape, as well as advancing scalable spin-wave-based information processing technologies.

AI.tldr: 利用硬磁球形微粒的杂散场在平整YIG薄膜中构建径向对称磁化分布，实验与微磁模拟共同证实自旋波可绕粒子循环多圈，实现2D自旋波导引。
AI.motivation: 自旋波计算的关键难题是引导自旋波而不产生波形畸变或反射，现有方案多局限于1D传播，难以用于2D磁子电路。
AI.method: 在平整YIG薄膜上放置硬磁球形微粒，其杂散场形成径向对称的磁化景观，使自旋波沿闭合圆形路径环绕传播；并进行微磁模拟复现实验条件。
AI.result: 实验观察到自旋波被引导至闭合路径，微磁模拟确认自旋波可绕粒子循环数圈。
AI.conclusion: 证明了利用非均匀磁化景观将自旋波导向圆形路径的可行性，为可扩展的自旋波信息处理技术提供新思路。

title: Initial-State-Dictated Dynamical Universality Classes in Quantum Criticality
summary: The concept of universality class lies at the core of phase transition physics, with each class uniquely characterized by a dedicated set of critical exponents. Here, we introduce the concept of initial-state-dictated dynamical universality classes in nonequilibrium quantum critical dynamics. By studying the imaginary-time relaxation dynamics of the dimerized Heisenberg model, we demonstrate that distinct kinds of initial states can give rise to different dynamical universality classes within the same equilibrium universality class. Specifically, we find that "classical'' paramagnetic (random-spin) and "quantum'' paramagnetic (dimerized and antidimerized) initial states yield drastically different critical initial slip exponents in the bulk. This initial-state dependence also extends to boundary critical dynamics, where different initial states yield different surface critical initial slip exponents even within the same boundary universality class. Remarkably, for the antidimerized initial state, we uncover an anomalous scaling law violating the conventional relation between the bulk and surface critical initial slip exponents. Our results establish an initial-state-controlled dynamical classification of quantum criticality that extends beyond the conventional equilibrium universality paradigm.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"初始态决定的动力学普适类"概念，通过对二聚化Heisenberg模型的虚时间弛豫动力学研究发现，同一平衡普适类下不同初始态会导致不同动力学普适类，并发现反二聚初始态下违反常规体-表面指数关系的反常标度律。
AI.motivation: 传统相变物理中普适类由临界指数唯一刻画，与微观细节无关。作者希望探究非平衡量子临界动力学中，初始态是否会在同一平衡普适类内催生出新的动力学普适分类，从而突破传统平衡普适范式的框架。
AI.method: 研究二聚化Heisenberg模型的虚时间弛豫动力学，对比"经典"顺磁（随机自旋）与"量子"顺磁（二聚化与反二聚化）初始态下的临界初始滑移行为，并同时考察体相与边界临界动力学，分析相应的临界初始滑移指数及其标度关系。
AI.result: 不同初始态给出显著不同的体相临界初始滑移指数；该初始态依赖性延伸至边界临界动力学，即使在同一边界普适类内，不同初始态也导致不同的表面临界初始滑移指数；特别地，反二聚初始态呈现出违反体相与表面临界初始滑移指数常规关系的反常标度律。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了由初始态控制的量子临界性动力学分类，表明动力学普适类可超越传统平衡普适范式，初始态应作为非平衡量子临界动力学分类的核心要素。

title: Orbital-angular-momentum control of localized Floquet states and photocurrents in Weyl semimetals
summary: Structured light provides a route to controlling quantum materials not only through its polarization, but also through its spatial profile and orbital angular momentum (OAM). We develop real space theories of a Weyl semimetal driven by a vortex beam and show that optical OAM generates highly localized Floquet vortex states with pronounced circulating photocurrents. Exploiting cylindrical symmetry, we derive a Bogoliubov-de Gennes-like radial equation that resolves the states by angular momentum and reveals their evolution between the light-dressed Weyl cones. For Laguerre-Gaussian beams, the spatially varying drive produces strong hybridization between localized vortex states and bulk states. We complement this continuum description with a Wilson-lattice formulation that retains the full two-dimensional spatial structure and enables direct calculation of local photocurrents. Both approaches consistently identify OAM-induced vortex states localized around the beam axis. The lattice calculation further shows that these states support substantially stronger circulating current densities than the more extended surface states, with the largest current densities associated with the most strongly localized, low-angular-momentum vortex modes. Our results establish optical OAM as a tunable control parameter for creating and manipulating localized current-carrying states in Weyl systems and provide a real-space framework for studying photocurrents generated by spatially structured light.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了涡旋光驱动外尔半金属的实空间理论，发现携带轨道角动量（OAM）的光可在外尔系统中产生高度局域化、具有显著环行光电流的 Floquet 涡旋态，并给出连续介质与 Wilson 格点两种一致框架。
AI.motivation: 结构光不仅是偏振工具，其空间分布与 OAM 也可作为调控量子材料的手段，但缺少实空间、能分辨角动量并直接计算局域光电流的理论框架。
AI.method: 构建实空间理论：利用柱对称性导出类 Bogoliubov–de Gennes 的径向方程，按角动量分辨光缀饰外尔锥间的涡旋态演化；对 Laguerre–Gaussian 光束处理局域涡旋态与体态的杂化；再用保留完整二维空间结构的 Wilson 格点模型计算局域光电流。
AI.result: 两种方法一致地给出围绕光束轴局域化的 OAM 诱导涡旋态；格点计算表明这些态支持的环行电流密度显著强于扩展表面态，且最强电流密度对应最局域、低角动量的涡旋模。
AI.conclusion: 光学 OAM 可作为在外尔体系中产生与操控局域载流态的可行调控参数，并提供研究空间结构光致光电流的实空间框架。

title: Quantum Formulation of the Spinterface Model
summary: We present a fully quantum formulation of the spinterface model for the chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS) effect, implemented within the non-equilibrium Green's function (NEGF) formalism. The model consists of a gold atom hosting a localised magnetic moment, coupled to a chiral molecular chain with Rashba spin-orbit coupling, and contacted by two non-magnetic leads. The magnetic moment is determined self-consistently from the non-equilibrium electronic distribution, and the spin-resolved transmission is computed from the mean-field Hamiltonian. We show that the interfacial magnetic moment and the chiral Rashba term cooperate to produce large current polarisations that reproduce the key experimental signatures of CISS: high polarisation, a threshold emergence at four total sites followed by interference-modulated growth with chain length, thermal suppression, and sign reversal upon chirality inversion. The central new result of this work is a clean separation of the CISS effect into an even (achiral) and an odd (chiral) contribution to the spin current, $I_{S_z}(φ) = I_{S_z}^{\rm even}(φ) + I_{S_z}^{\rm odd}(φ)$. We demonstrate that $I_{S_z}^{\rm odd}$ vanishes exactly at fixed $m_z$ for chains of fewer than four sites and becomes non-zero for chains of four or more sites, with the smallest junction exhibiting a non-zero odd part being the four-site geometry (one gold atom plus three molecular sites). The odd part arises from reciprocity breaking in a device that is simultaneously chiral, magnetically asymmetric (moment on the gold end only), and long enough to support two or more Rashba-active bonds. This provides a direct, parameter-free test of whether an observed spin signal is genuinely chiral or arises from an achiral spin-valve mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文在NEGF框架下给出CISS效应spinterface模型的全量子表述，提出将自旋流分解为偶（非手性）与奇（手性）两部分，并证明奇部在手性分子少于4个位点时严格为零。
AI.motivation: CISS实验观测到的自旋极化常与非手性自旋阀机制混淆，缺少一个能无参数地区分"真手性信号"与"非手性自旋阀效应"的判据。
AI.method: 构建金原子局域磁矩＋Rashba自旋轨道耦合手性分子链＋两个非磁电极的结，用NEGF与平均场自洽求解非平衡电子分布下的磁矩，计算自旋分辨透射，并把自旋流按手性对称性拆为偶部与奇部。
AI.result: 模型重现CISS主要实验特征：高极化率、4位点阈值后随链长受干涉调制增长、热抑制、手性反转时符号改变。奇部在固定m_z下少于4位点严格为零，最小非零体系为4位点（1金+3分子位点）。
AI.conclusion: 奇部的出现需同时满足三个条件：手性、磁性不对称（磁矩仅在一端）、至少两个Rashba活性键，源于互易性破缺；据此可给出判断自旋信号是否真正手性的无参数检验。

title: Grain-Boundary Scattering between Chiral Domains in Chiral Topological Semimetal CoSi
summary: We evaluate the electron scattering properties in CoSi thin films having either twin (heterochiral) or non-twin (homochiral) grain boundaries using first-principles quantum transport calculations. We find that scattering across a twin grain boundary is more resistive than scattering across a non-twin grain boundary and that non-twin grain boundaries have a greater percentage of surface conduction than twin grain boundaries. This is corroborated by the transmission eigenstate profiles, which show that the surface Fermi-arc electrons can transmit past the non-twin grain boundaries between homochiral domains on the same surface without significant backscattering. In contrast, these surface electrons get scattered along the twin grain boundaries between heterochiral domains to the opposite surface, resulting in partial forward transmission and partial backscattering that yields higher grain-boundary resistivity. This work helps elucidate the complexities of electron transport in chiral topological semimetals for potential application in next-generation nano-interconnects.

AI.tldr: 利用第一性原理量子输运计算比较CoSi薄膜中孪晶（异手性）与非孪晶（同手性）晶界的电子散射，发现孪晶界电阻更大、表面输运比例更低。
AI.motivation: 手性拓扑半金属（如CoSi）在下一代纳米互连中有应用潜力，但其薄膜中晶界类型（孪晶/非孪晶，即异手性/同手性）如何影响电子输运尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理量子输运计算，对含孪晶（异手性）与非孪晶（同手性）晶界的CoSi薄膜进行电子散射性质评估，并结合透射本征态分布进行分析。
AI.result: 孪晶晶界的散射电阻高于非孪晶晶界；非孪晶晶界的表面导百分比更大。透射本征态表明，表面费米弧电子可在同一表面上同手性畴间的非孪晶晶界处无显著背散射地透射；而在异手性畴间的孪晶晶界处，表面电子被散射至对立表面，形成部分前向透射与部分背散射，导致更高晶界电阻率。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了手性拓扑半金属中电子输运的复杂性，为纳米互连应用提供了物理理解。

title: Sum-over-poles framework for quantum embedding to approach the real-frequency axis
summary: We introduce a real-frequency framework for the quantum embedding of solids, based on sum-over-poles (SOP) representations. We partition the lattice into periodically repeated interacting fragments and derive an embedded Dyson equation for the fragment, to be solved self-consistently. The resulting scheme generalizes the algorithmic-inversion method of our previous work to interacting Hamiltonians and is closely related to dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT), especially when an extended impurity problem is introduced. By exploiting the compact pole expansion of the embedding potential, we carry out the self-consistent procedure close to the real axis, which avoids ill-posed analytic continuation. In addition, the SOP representation allows us to introduce a pole-and-residue dynamics, which we use to reach the self-consistent solution. After deriving the method, we benchmark it against exact-diagonalization implementations of DMFT on the one-dimensional Hubbard ring at half filling. The framework offers a natural route to real-space dynamical quantum embedding, for periodic systems as well as for strongly correlated defects in materials.

AI.tldr: 提出基于求和极点(SOP)表示的真实频率量子嵌入框架，将晶格划分为周期重复的相互作用碎片，自洽求解嵌入Dyson方程；避免病态解析延拓，并用极点-留数动力学达到自洽解，在1D半满Hubbard环上对标DMFT精确对角化。
AI.motivation: 固体量子嵌入（如DMFT）通常需在虚轴计算再做解析延拓，该过程病态不稳健；作者希望直接在实频率附近完成自洽计算，并推广此前工作（算法反演方法）至相互作用哈密顿量。
AI.method: 将晶格分为周期重复的相互作用碎片，导出碎片的嵌入Dyson方程并联立自洽求解（推广算法反演方法，与DMFT/扩展杂质问题密切相关）；利用嵌入势的紧凑极点展开，在靠近实轴处执行自洽程序，并引入极点-留数（pole-and-residue）动力学驱动迭代至自洽。
AI.result: 在一维半满Hubbard环上与DMFT的精确对角化实现进行了基准对比，验证了该框架的正确性与可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为避免解析延拓提供了自然途径，并可推广至实空间动力学量子嵌入，适用于周期体系及材料中强关联缺陷。

title: Multiscale Modeling of Zr Corrosion: Predicting Microstructures of Oxide Films
comment: 42 pages, 22 figures, 4 tables. Accepted manuscript of the article published in Journal of Nuclear Materials 625 (2026) 156521, under a CC BY 4.0 license
summary: A first-principles-informed multiscale modeling approach is reported for oxide formation during corrosion of zirconium. The present simulations reproduce the columnar corrosion film microstructure and grain size distribution seen in micrographs of oxidized Zr surfaces. This structural feature emerges from a hexagonal ZrO layer adjacent to the $α$-Zr/ZrO$_{2-x}$ interface, which is dynamically stabilized by continuous heterogeneous grain nucleation and grain boundary mass diffusion. This ZrO layer is identified as a significant oxygen diffusion barrier and a potential contributor to sub-parabolic pretransition corrosion kinetics. The simulations also reproduce the undulatory nature of the metal/oxide interface, leading to regions with tensile stress components capable of nucleating cracks, despite the overall state of compressive hydrostatic stress within the oxide film. First principles density functional theory (DFT) computations of fundamental ZrO$_x$ properties were combined with molecular dynamics simulations using a machine-learned potential based on a DFT training set to provide extensive input to an advanced phase field model for oxide formation and its microstructure, as implemented in the new MedeA PhaseField module. The phase field simulations reported herein incorporated computed stoichiometry-dependent thermochemical data, anisotropic elastic properties, interface energies, bulk and grain boundary mass transport processes, multiphase heterogeneous grain nucleation, and strain energy-dependent phase stabilities.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种第一性原理驱动的多尺度建模方法研究锆腐蚀氧化膜形成，成功复现了柱状晶微观结构、晶粒尺寸分布及金属/氧化物界面起伏，并识别出界面处六方ZrO层为重要氧扩散屏障。
AI.motivation: 锆合金腐蚀中氧化膜的形成机制及其微观结构演化尚不清楚，尤其是柱状晶组织、界面形貌与亚抛物线预过渡动力学的物理起源缺乏统一的多尺度理解。
AI.method: 结合DFT计算ZrOx基本性质与基于DFT训练集的机器学习势分子动力学模拟，为MedeA PhaseField模块中的先进相场模型提供输入；相场模拟纳入化学计量依赖的热化学数据、各向异性弹性、界面能、体相与晶界质量输运、多相异质晶核及应变能依赖的相稳定性。
AI.result: 模拟复现了显微照片中观察到的柱状腐蚀膜微观结构和晶粒尺寸分布；结构源自α-Zr/ZrO2-x界面附近由连续异质晶核与晶界扩散动态稳定的六方ZrO层；该层为显著氧扩散屏障，可能贡献亚抛物线预过渡腐蚀动力学；模拟还复现了起伏金属/氧化物界面，局部拉应力可萌生裂纹，尽管氧化膜整体处于压应力状态。
AI.conclusion: 该多尺度第一性原理-相场框架可定量再现锆氧化膜的关键结构与力学特征，揭示界面ZrO层的扩散屏障作用及界面起伏引起的局部拉应力裂纹萌生机制，为理解锆腐蚀动力学提供理论依据。

title: Symmetry-Guided Machine Learning of Spin-Dependent Nonlinear Hall Response
summary: A Berry-curvature dipole can produce a nonlinear Hall current even when the linear Hall response vanishes, but symmetry alone does not determine its magnitude or magnetic tunability. The interplay of structural symmetry, moment orientation, and carrier occupation is examined in a honeycomb model. Curvature maps and the band-summed dipole integrand reveal how velocity and the occupation window near the Fermi level select signed contributions. Removing threefold rotation permits a nonmagnetic dipole perpendicular to the surviving mirror. Generic magnetic reorientation activates the second component and tunes both components through positive and negative values. Global reversal preserves the dipole while reversing the intrinsic linear Hall conductivity, allowing a finite bulk dipole contribution from equally populated reversed domains under uniform-field averaging.A symmetry-constrained polynomial model predicts both dipole components for 256 held-out spin configurations, achieving coefficients of determination $R^2 > 0.9995$ at the reference chemical potential. At fixed carrier density, orientation-dependent shifts of the chemical potential modify the response and yield slightly larger prediction errors for the chosen model. Across the chemical-potential sweep,the prediction accuracy decreases more strongly for $D_y$,revealing an energy dependence of the surrogate's performance. Within semiclassical transport with a constant relaxation time, the calculated dipole determines the angular dependence of the quadratic current and its rectified and second-harmonic components. These results provide a quantitative representation of magnetic-orientation-dependent Berry-curvature dipoles and show how carrier occupation influences both the response and its predictability.

AI.tldr: 本文在蜂窝模型中系统研究Berry曲率偶极子的对称性、磁矩取向与载流子占据三者的相互作用，揭示磁重取向可连续调节偶极分量，并建立对称约束多项式模型高精度预测偶极，讨论其能量依赖与二次霍尔电流的角度依赖。
AI.motivation: Berry曲率偶极可在线性霍尔响应为零时产生非线性霍尔电流，但仅凭对称性无法确定其大小及磁可调性，需厘清结构对称性、磁矩取向和载流子占据如何共同决定偶极的符号与幅度。
AI.method: 构建蜂窝格点模型，绘制曲率分布与能带求和的偶极被积函数，分析费米面附近速度与占据窗口对带符号贡献的选择作用；去除三重旋转对称以允许垂直于剩余镜面的非磁偶极；用对称约束多项式模型拟合偶极随磁取向的变化，并在固定化学势与固定载流子密度两种情形下评估预测精度；在半经典输运、常数弛豫时间下由偶极导出二次电流及其整流、二倍频分量的角度依赖。
AI.result: 磁重取向可激活第二偶极分量并使两分量取正负值连续可调；整体磁反转保持偶极不变而反转本征线性霍尔电导，使等量反向畴在均匀场平均下仍给出有限体偶极贡献。对称约束多项式对256个留出自旋构型预测R²>0.9995（参考化学势）；固定载流子密度时化学势随取向移动使误差略增；扫描化学势时Dy的预测精度下降更快，显示代理模型的能量依赖。
AI.conclusion: 结果给出磁取向依赖的Berry曲率偶极的定量描述，并表明载流子占据同时影响非线性霍尔响应及其可预测性。

title: Acceleration of CTQMC via Denoising Diffusion Models with Auxiliary Spectral Functions
summary: Continuous-time Quantum Monte Carlo (CTQMC) impurity solvers are a numerically exact, but expensive, option for solving the Dynamical Mean Field Theory (DMFT) equations, with statistical noise from undersampling presenting a major challenge to low temperature studies. This noise is especially egregious within the sampled self-energy, which can destabilize the self-consistency loop upon insertion into the Dyson equation. In this work, we introduce a neural denoiser for fermionic imaginary time Green's functions based on the diffusion model architecture trained on synthetic data. The network predicts positive and normalized auxiliary spectral functions consistent with the noisy imaginary axis CTQMC data, which is then refined via autodifferentiation to match the measured self-energy, its first two high-frequency moments, and impurity occupation similar to the Constrained Residual Minimization (CRM) method. This leads to Green's functions and self-energies that are causal by design. Through this denoising framework we are able to reduce the required CTQMC measurement steps by a factor of 10-100. We benchmark our method with a half-filled Hubbard model on a Bethe lattice, a two-patch Dynamical Cluster Approximation (DCA) of the two-dimensional Hubbard model, and the SrVO$_3$ system. We reproduce the Mott transition upon increasing Coulomb interaction for the half-filled Hubbard model with only 5000 CTQMC measurements, the pseudogap transition for the DCA two-dimensional Hubbard model with only 5$\times$10$^5$ measurements, and match the spectral function of SrVO$_3$ with 50 times fewer measurements than the reference. Since we generate auxiliary spectral functions, we recover the approximate spectral functions of the systems for free without performing analytic continuation.

AI.tldr: 提出基于扩散模型的神经去噪器，用于连续时间量子蒙特卡洛（CTQMC）虚时格林函数的去噪，可将所需测量步数减少10–100倍，并免费获得近似谱函数。
AI.motivation: CTQMC 杂质求解器虽数值精确但计算昂贵，欠采样带来的统计噪声严重影响低温研究；噪声在自能中尤为突出，插入 Dyson 方程后会破坏 DMFT 自洽循环的稳定性。
AI.method: 在合成数据上训练基于扩散模型架构的神经去噪器，从含噪虚轴 CTQMC 数据预测正且归一的辅助谱函数；再通过自动微分，仿照约束残差最小化（CRM）方法，使结果匹配测量的自能、其前两个高频矩以及杂质占据数，从设计上保证格林函数与自能具有因果性。
AI.result: 在 Bethe 晶格半满 Hubbard 模型、二维 Hubbard 模型的二片 DCA、以及 SrVO₃ 体系上验证：仅用 5000 次 CTQMC 测量即重现 Mott 转变，仅用 5×10⁵ 次测量重现 DCA 二维 Hubbard 模型的赝能隙转变，并以比参考少 50 倍的测量匹配 SrVO₃ 谱函数。
AI.conclusion: 该去噪框架显著降低 CTQMC 测量成本（10–100倍），保证因果性，并可直接由辅助谱函数获得体系近似谱函数，无需另做解析延拓。

title: Differentiable powder X-ray diffraction enables analysis of evolving structures
summary: Operando and in-situ experiments extend powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) to materials that evolve during experiments, producing series of hundreds or thousands of patterns. Such series are commonly refined one pattern at a time, so weak signals give noisy structural trajectories. Parametric refinement instead fits a shared model to all patterns, but with most existing programs, changing the model or fitting it efficiently remains challenging. Here, we introduce diffPXRD, a differentiable PXRD engine in PyTorch. diffPXRD calculates derivatives by automatic differentiation, so a shared model can be changed without new derivative code. Batched fitting is also more than seven times faster than serial fitting. In an operando cathode series, a shared lattice model can reduce lattice-parameter variability by 68.4% when 10% of the photon counts are retained. We also show shared models can describe the precipitation and dissolution of Li2S and reconstruct collective atomic displacements in Ca3Ti2O7.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 diffPXRD，一个基于 PyTorch 的可微分粉末 X 射线衍射（PXRD）引擎，支持对整序列图谱进行参数化联合拟合，可自动求导并批量加速。
AI.motivation: 原位/operando PXRD 实验产生数百至数千张演化图谱，逐张精修导致弱信号下结构轨迹噪声大；现有参数化精修程序难以修改模型或高效拟合。
AI.method: 在 PyTorch 中实现可微分 PXRD 计算引擎，利用自动微分获得导数，无需为新模型编写导数代码；并采用批量（batched）拟合策略。
AI.result: 批量拟合比串行拟合快 7 倍以上；在仅保留 10% 光子计数的 operando 正极序列中，共享晶格模型使晶格参数波动降低 68.4%；共享模型还能描述 Li2S 的沉淀与溶解，并重建 Ca3Ti2O7 中的集体原子位移。
AI.conclusion: diffPXRD 提供了灵活、高效的共享模型拟合框架，显著改善低计数 PXRD 序列的结构轨迹质量，并拓展到相变与原子位移分析。

title: Correcting topographic artifacts in three-dimensional ToF-SIMS: A practical guide from data-only reconstruction to correlative AFM
comment: 37 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables; supplementary material included (7 pages). Submitted to J. Vac. Sci. Technol. B (Tutorial). Data and code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23348079
summary: Three-dimensional time-of-flight secondary ion mass spectrometry (3D ToF-SIMS) builds chemical volumes by stacking images acquired between sputter cycles. Standard reconstruction assumes a flat starting surface and a single sputter rate, so samples with topography, or with layers that sputter at different rates, yield distorted interface positions and depth scales. This article is a practical guide to correcting these artifacts. We group the available corrections by the information they need: the SIMS data alone, atomic force microscopy (AFM) topography before and after the profile, or AFM topography also at intermediate stages. All three are applied to a model Pt/TaOx/Ta/Pt/Ti crossbar memristor device measured with in situ SIMS/AFM at ten stages, together with the data preparation they share. Each correction method is evaluated using the known device geometry and the measured surface evolution. The data-only correction requires no additional instrumentation and restores relative topography, but its depth scale depends on nominal layer thicknesses and remains unconstrained below the last calibrated interface. AFM before and after the profile fixes the start and end surfaces but assumes uniform sputtering in between, which fails next to the device, where the surroundings change material during the profile. Multi-stage AFM correction follows these changes and reproduces the structure of the device, at the cost of instrument time and repeated imaging of a partially sputtered surface. A decision flowchart and a checklist help readers choose, validate and report a correction.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇实用指南，系统总结并比较了3D ToF-SIMS深度重建中地形/不同溅射速率所致伪影的三类校正方法，并以Pt/TaOx/Ta/Pt/Ti忆阻器件为模型进行验证。
AI.motivation: 标准3D ToF-SIMS重建假设起始表面平坦且溅射速率单一，对具地形或分层溅射速率不同的样品会产生界面位置与深度标度失真，缺乏便于实践者选择的校正方案指导。
AI.method: 按所需信息对校正方法分组：(1)仅用SIMS数据；(2)剖面测量前后AFM形貌；(3)含中间阶段的多次AFM形貌。三类方法均应用于原位SIMS/AFM十阶段测量的Pt/TaOx/Ta/Pt/Ti交叉阵列忆阻器件，并共享同一数据预处理流程，借助已知器件几何与实测表面演化进行评估。
AI.result: 纯数据法无需额外仪器、可恢复相对形貌，但深度标度依赖名义层厚且在最后校准界面以下无约束；前后AFM法固定起止表面但假设中间均匀溅射，在器件周边材料变化处失效；多阶段AFM法能跟踪变化并正确再现器件结构，代价是仪器时间与对部分溅射表面的重复成像。
AI.conclusion: 提供决策流程图与检查清单，帮助读者选择、验证并规范报告校正方法；校正精度与所需额外测量（AFM阶段数）之间存在权衡。

title: GBClaw: An agentic AI framework for atomistic grain boundary research and mechanistic discovery
summary: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems hold immense potential for automating complex workflows in materials discovery and design, but extending them to domain-intensive mechanistic investigations remains challenging. Here, we present GBClaw, an agentic AI framework for investigating the structure and deformation of general grain boundaries (GBs). Although general GBs constitute the vast majority of real-world interfaces in polycrystalline materials, they remain understudied because their structural complexity and interfacial mismatch complicate experimental and modeling research. GBClaw integrates large language models (LLMs) into a modular architecture comprising an orchestrator, specialized agents, domain-specific tools, simulation interfaces, and hierarchical memory. Through dynamic replanning and iterative workflow refinement, the framework effectively connects systematic simulations with targeted mechanistic analysis. Applied to 14 general asymmetric tilt GBs in nickel, GBClaw characterized interfacial defect structures and identified diverse deformation modes across these incommensurate boundaries. Comparing boundary sliding with and without secondary GB misfit dislocations revealed substantial differences in shear strength, underscoring the critical role of defect hierarchies in sliding resistance. Furthermore, researcher-guided follow-up calculations traced an anomalously high shear resistance to metastable boundary structures. This work demonstrates that combining agentic AI with domain expertise bridges high-throughput computational screening with deep physical understanding of complex material interfaces.

AI.tldr: 提出GBClaw——一个用于研究一般晶界结构与变形的智能体AI框架，整合LLM编排器、专用智能体、领域工具、仿真接口与分层记忆，并在镍的14个非对称倾斜晶界上揭示缺陷层级对滑移抗力的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 智能体AI在材料发现工作流自动化方面潜力巨大，但推广到需要深厚领域知识的机理研究仍有困难。一般晶界占多晶材料实际界面绝大多数，却因结构复杂、界面失配而研究不足，实验与建模均困难。
AI.method: 构建模块化智能体架构（编排器、专用智能体、领域工具、仿真接口、分层记忆），通过动态重规划与迭代式工作流精炼，将系统化仿真与针对性机理分析相连接；应用于镍中14个一般非对称倾斜晶界，表征界面缺陷结构并比较有无二次晶界失配位错时的滑移行为，并辅以研究者引导的后续计算。
AI.result: 识别出这些非公度晶界中多样的变形模式；有/无二次晶界失配位错的滑移在剪切强度上差异显著，表明缺陷层级在滑移抗力中的关键作用；研究者引导的后续计算将异常高的剪切抗力归因于亚稳晶界结构。
AI.conclusion: 智能体AI与领域专业知识结合，可打通高通量计算筛选与对复杂材料界面的深层物理理解，为机理型材料研究提供可行范式。

title: Commutative Coarse-graining on the Sphere
comment: 7 pages + 1 page Supplementary Material, submitted to Europhysics Letters: Focus Issue on Complex Flows and Complex Fluids
summary: Filtering by spatial convolution underlies coarse-graining and Large Eddy Simulation, the analysis of multiscale dynamics, and data processing across the sciences. Yet, as commonly practiced on the sphere, it violates a basic consistency requirement: commutation with differential operators, which is necessary for deriving coarse-grained dynamics and preserving the physics across lengthscales. We discuss the root of the problem, which is intrinsic to the curved geometry rather than being a result of metric terms, coordinate system, or numerical grid. A recently proposed generalized spherical convolution is, for a given scalar kernel, the unique linear operator commuting with the radial projection, divergence, and curl. Any consistent linear operator, be it spectral truncation, wavelet transform, diffusion, Green's-function inversion, or a machine-learned convolution, necessarily takes this form. From a simulation of an unstable jet, we demonstrate commutation to within numerical round-off, whereas common filtering that ignores curvature produces significant spurious divergence where none exists and gradient errors comparable to the gradients themselves.

AI.tldr: 球面上常规的空间卷积滤波无法与微分算子交换，根源是曲率几何本身，而非度规项、坐标系或数值网格。作者指出广义球面卷积是与径向投影、散度和旋度都交换的唯一线性算子形式，任何一致线性算子（谱截断、小波、扩散、格林函数反演或机器学习卷积）都必须如此。
AI.motivation: 空间卷积滤波是粗粒化、大涡模拟（LES）、多尺度动力学分析与科学数据处理的基础工具，但在球面上常用的滤波方式违反了与微分算子交换这一基本一致性要求，而该性质是推导粗粒化动力学、保持跨尺度物理一致性的必要条件。
AI.method: 从几何角度分析问题根源，论证其内在性（曲率所致）；基于最近提出的广义球面卷积构造：对给定标量核，它是唯一与径向投影、散度、旋度均交换的线性算子，并说明其他各类线性算子均被此形式涵盖；在不稳定射流模拟中做数值验证，与忽略曲率的常规滤波对比。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，广义球面卷积的交换误差在数值舍入量级；而忽略曲率的常见滤波在原本无散度处产生显著虚假散度，梯度误差与梯度本身量级相当。
AI.conclusion: 球面滤波的一致性问题具有普适性，广义球面卷积提供了理论上唯一正确、实践上可行的滤波框架，应作为球面粗粒化与LES等应用的标准工具。

title: Matrix-Free Resolvent Analysis for Large-Scale Aerodynamic Systems
summary: At industrial scale the cost of resolvent analysis is set by the linear solves and the assembly and storage of the Jacobian. We present a matrix-free resolvent framework in the Reynolds-averaged Navier-Stokes solver ADflow: automatic differentiation supplies the action of the shifted Jacobian and its Hermitian transpose, preconditioned Krylov solves recycle subspaces across a Lanczos bidiagonalization, and every gain is certified by a backward error. It is applied to the NASA Common Research Model wing at Mach 0.85 and 4.2 degrees on three grid levels of 0.45, 3.6 and 28.8 million cells, the finest with 1.73x10^8 complex unknowns, 2.3 times the largest reported resolvent computation. On the coarsest level an unstable buffet mode makes the gain peak a resonance; on the finer two the operator is stable and the peak, 1.33x10^4 at omega = 6.4 and 3.0x10^3 near omega = 7.7, is a pseudo-resonance of damped modes whose buffet cells travel outboard at about 0.3 times the free-stream speed. Refinement turns an oscillator into an amplifier of the same mechanism, as forced simulations confirm. A certified frequency costs 3.6 minutes on 128 cores at 2.7 million unknowns, with 14 to 34 kB per unknown, nearly four orders of magnitude below a sparse factorization.

AI.tldr: 提出ADflow中的无矩阵resolvent（预解）分析框架，用自动微分+子空间回收的Krylov求解，并在CRS翼型上完成最高1.73亿未知数的预解计算，揭示粗网格的buffet为共振、细网格为同一机制的伪共振放大器。
AI.motivation: 工业级预解分析的成本由线性求解以及Jacobian的组装与存储决定，传统稀疏分解难以扩展到上亿未知数规模。
AI.method: 在RANS求解器ADflow中构建无矩阵预解框架：自动微分提供移位Jacobian及其Hermitian转置的作用；预条件Krylov求解在Lanczos双对角化中回收子空间；每个增益均由后向误差认证。
AI.result: 应用于NASA CRM翼（Ma=0.85，4.2°），三级网格0.45M/3.6M/28.8M单元，最细1.73×10^8复未知数（为已报道最大预解计算的2.3倍）。粗网格存在不稳定buffet模态使增益峰为共振；细网格算子稳定，峰值为ω=6.4处1.33×10^4及ω≈7.7处3.0×10^3，属阻尼模态的伪共振，buffet胞以约0.3倍自由来流速度向外翼传播。加密将振子变为同机制的放大器，强迫仿真证实。单频认证在128核上2.7M未知数耗时3.6分钟，每未知数14–34 kB，比稀疏分解低近四个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 无矩阵+认证误差的预解框架可实现工业规模（上亿未知数）的稳定预解分析，成本远低于稀疏分解，并能区分真实共振与伪共振、追踪网格加密下的机制演变。

title: FoundPDE: A generative foundation model for data-driven symbolic discovery of partial differential equations
summary: Discovering governing partial differential equations (PDEs) from observed data is a central inverse problem in computational science and engineering: the goal is not only to predict trajectories, but to identify interpretable symbolic laws that can be analyzed and reused. Existing PDE discovery methods often depend on hand-designed libraries, accurate numerical derivatives, or per-equation symbolic search, making them fragile under sparse observations, noisy data, broad equation families, and unseen symbolic compositions. Here, we introduce FoundPDE, a pretrained data-to-symbol foundation model for PDE discovery. FoundPDE maps discretized spatio-temporal trajectories to symbolic equations with a transformer, uses Fourier and first-order spatial-derivative augmentation to expose complementary trajectory information, refines numerical coefficients, and supports downstream extension with improved generalization through few-shot fine-tuning and hierarchical discovery. On a clean in-domain benchmark spanning 20 PDE families, our model reaches 97.50% type recognition. Under coefficient shifts beyond the training support, type recognition remains 90.53%; under multiplicative Gaussian noise on the model input, it is 94.43% at a 2% noise level but falls to 52.09% at 10%. For unseen composite equations, few-shot fine-tuning reaches over 90% exact recovery on four held-out families, and we further develop a hierarchical discovery algorithm that recovers two-term composites without fine-tuning FoundPDE. By amortizing symbolic discovery across equation families, FoundPDE shifts PDE discovery from per-dataset search toward a reusable pretrained model that extends to new physics with limited additional data, a step toward foundation models that uncover interpretable governing laws directly from scientific data.

AI.tldr: FoundPDE 是一个预训练的"数据到符号"PDE 发现基础模型，用 Transformer 将离散时空轨迹直接映射为符号方程，在 20 类 PDE 上达到 97.50% 类型识别率。
AI.motivation: 现有 PDE 发现方法依赖人工设计库、精确数值导数或逐方程符号搜索，在稀疏观测、噪声、广泛方程族及未见符号组合下脆弱，缺乏可复用的预训练模型。
AI.method: 以 Transformer 将离散时空轨迹映射为符号方程；采用傅里叶变换与一阶空间导数增广提供互补轨迹信息；对数值系数进行精修；支持少样本微调与层次化发现以推广到下游任务。
AI.result: 干净域内 20 个 PDE 族基准上类型识别 97.50%；系数偏移超训练范围仍有 90.53%；2% 乘性高斯噪声下 94.43%，10% 噪声降至 52.09%；四个未见复合方程族少样本微调后精确恢复超 90%；无需微调的层次化算法可恢复两项复合方程。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨方程族摊销符号发现，FoundPDE 将 PDE 发现从逐数据集搜索转向可复用预训练模型，可用少量额外数据扩展到新物理，是通向直接从科学数据中挖掘可解释支配定律的基础模型的一步。

title: Load-Balanced Neural-Network-Aided Adaptive Tabulation of Phase Equilibria for Transcritical Multiphase Flows
summary: Simulating high-pressure transcritical flows with phase change is critical for advanced propulsion, yet traditional first-principles approaches, vapor-liquid equilibrium (VLE) calculations, consume most of the runtime and frequently fail to converge. Standalone machine learning models introduce heavy evaluation overhead across large grids, while dynamic tabulation still relies on fragile iterative solvers. To resolve these limitations, this study introduces a hybrid In-Situ Adaptive Tabulation and Artificial Neural Network (ISAT-ANN) framework. A pre-trained ANN replaces the iterative solver during table expansion to guarantee crash-free operation, while ISAT enables rapid data retrieval via local linear interpolation. To eliminate parallel load imbalances, an O(N) greedy load-balancing algorithm redistributes computational tasks across cores. Coupled with Adaptive Mesh Refinement (AMR), the framework was validated on a Mach 5 shock-droplet interaction benchmark. It accurately captured shock-interface dynamics without instability, achieving a 2.30 times speedup in thermodynamic calculations on a single core and 2.62 times in parallel over standalone ANNs, with AMR providing an additional 2.92 times overall efficiency boost. This plug-and-play framework offers a stable, scalable path for high-fidelity multiphase flow simulations.

AI.tldr: 提出ISAT-ANN混合框架，用预训练ANN替代迭代求解器做建表扩展、ISAT做快速检索，配合O(N)贪心负载均衡和AMR，在Mach 5激波-液滴相互作用算例中实现热力学计算单核2.30倍、并行2.62倍加速，AMR再带来2.92倍整体效率提升。
AI.motivation: 高压跨临界含相变流动仿真的传统第一性原理VLE计算耗时大且常不收敛；独立ML模型在大网格上评估开销高，动态建表仍依赖脆弱的迭代求解器，需要兼顾稳定性与效率的方案。
AI.method: 构建ISAT-ANN混合框架：预训练ANN在建表扩展时替代迭代求解器以保证无崩溃运行，ISAT通过局部线性插值实现快速数据检索；用O(N)贪心负载均衡算法在核间重分配任务以消除并行负载不均；并与AMR耦合。
AI.result: 在Mach 5激波-液滴相互作用基准上验证，稳定准确地捕捉激波-界面动力学；热力学计算单核加速2.30倍，并行较独立ANN加速2.62倍，AMR额外带来2.92倍整体效率提升。
AI.conclusion: 该即插即用框架为高保真多相流仿真提供了稳定、可扩展的路径。

title: Machine-learned spectral PDE solvers for fluids and plasmas
summary: Sparse regression methods for discovering governing partial differential equations (PDEs) from data are sensitive to observation noise and are not constrained to reproduce the data under forward integration. We address both limitations by performing weak-form discovery in the spatial discretization in which the PDE is solved, learned by differentiating through multistep rollouts anchored at the observed states. The new method, Weak-form Anchored Rollout for PDEs (WARP), produces a machine-learned PDE solver. In this work, we focus on systems amenable to a spectral Galerkin solver. Across eight benchmark fluid and plasma systems, including high-dimensional turbulent simulations, WARP produces numerically stable rollouts from new random initial conditions and substantially improves coefficient recovery, rollout accuracy, and statistical measures compared with a single-step weak-form SINDy baseline.

AI.tldr: WARP：在谱离散下做弱形式PDE发现，通过以观测状态为锚点的多步滚动反向传播，得到机器学习PDE求解器，稳定性和系数恢复优于弱形式SINDy。
AI.motivation: 稀疏回归类PDE发现方法（如弱形式SINDy）对观测噪声敏感，且不受前向积分数值稳定性的约束，学到的方程在新初始条件下可能发散。
AI.method: 在与求解PDE相同的空间离散（谱Galerkin）中作弱形式发现；以观测状态为锚点进行多步滚动，并对滚动过程求导（differentiation through rollouts）来学习系数，从而把求解器本身作为学习对象。
AI.result: 在八个流体与等离子体基准系统（含高维湍流模拟）上，WARP在新随机初始条件下给出数值稳定的滚动，系数恢复、滚动精度与统计量均显著优于单步弱形式SINDy基线。
AI.conclusion: 将弱形式发现与前向滚动稳定性目标结合可有效缓解噪声敏感与积分发散问题，输出可直接用作稳定求解器的PDE模型。

title: Proper generalized decomposition with synthetic preconditioning for multiscale parametric phonon transport
summary: Deterministic solution of the phonon Boltzmann transport equation is costly for two reasons: the distribution depends on high-dimensional phase space, and source iteration converges slowly when scattering is frequent. We address both for the steady linearized gray Callaway model in two dimensions by combining proper generalized decomposition (PGD) with the general synthetic iterative scheme (GSIS). The distribution is a sum of products of a space--azimuth factor and a polar factor. This splitting is intrinsically low-rank: along each characteristic the polar angle only stretches the in-plane optical depth, so the rank is bounded, uniformly in the Knudsen numbers, by the numerical rank of the kernel $\exp(-τ/\sinφ)$. PGD--GSIS updates the factors against a macroscopic source frozen within each alternating step and refreshed by the GSIS moment equations. A Fourier analysis shows that pure PGD, although implicit in the polar factor, moves macroscopic information only through lagged spatial sweeps and stalls like source iteration, whereas the synthetic refresh sees only third-order moments of the representation error. On an isothermal cavity, cross-plane conduction and phonon Poiseuille flow, PGD--GSIS reproduces full-order solutions at ranks 3--14, with heat-flux errors below $6\times10^{-3}$ from the diffusive to the ballistic regime and memory independent of the polar resolution. Treating the inverse Knudsen numbers as coordinates of the polar factor yields one spatial basis over four decades of both; a joint update of all polar factors, which costs only small nodal linear systems, is required for accuracy at large Knudsen numbers.

AI.tldr: 本文将PGD（本征广义分解）与GSIS（通用合成迭代格式）结合，求解二维稳态线性化灰体Callaway模型的声子玻尔兹曼输运方程，实现低秩、收敛快、内存与极角分辨率无关的确定性解。
AI.motivation: 声子BTE确定性求解面临两大困难：分布函数依赖高维相空间（空间×方位角×极角），计算昂贵；散射频繁时源迭代收敛极慢。需要同时解决维度灾难与迭代收敛问题。
AI.method: 将分布函数分解为"空间-方位因子"与"极角因子"乘积求和，利用沿特征线极角仅拉伸面内光学厚度的低秩结构（秩由核exp(-τ/sinφ)的数值秩一致界定）。PGD-GSIS交替更新因子：每步冻结宏观源，并用GSIS矩方程刷新宏观源。用Fourier分析比较纯PGD与PGD-GSIS的收敛性；进一步把逆Knudsen数作为极角因子坐标，并对所有极角因子联合更新。
AI.result: Fourier分析表明纯PGD虽对极角因子隐式，但宏观信息仅通过滞后空间扫描传递，收敛如源迭代般停滞；而合成刷新仅感知表示误差的三阶矩。在等温腔、跨面传导与声子Poiseuille流算例中，PGD-GSIS以秩3–14复现全阶解，从扩散到弹道区热流误差低于6×10⁻³，且内存与极角分辨率无关；逆Knudsen数作坐标可跨四个数量级用单一空间基；大Knudsen数下需联合更新全部极角因子（仅需小规模节点线性系统）才能保证精度。
AI.conclusion: PGD与GSIS结合可有效突破声子BTE的高维与慢收敛双重瓶颈，得到与极角分辨率无关的低秩高精度解；关键设计是宏观源的合成刷新及大Knudsen数下极角因子的联合更新。

title: DeHNSSo-v2: A compressible, curvilinear, and efficient extension of the Delft Harmonic Navier-Stokes Solver
summary: We present DeHNSSo-v2, a major update of DeHNSSo-v1 (Westerbeek et al., Comput. Phys. Commun. 302, 2024), the open-source Delft Harmonic Navier-Stokes Solver for nonlinear stability analysis of shear flows. The new release adds a compressible formulation on general two-dimensional body-fitted geometries, automatic grid generation, linear-cost sparse assembly, reusable per-mode factorizations, and Newton pseudo-arclength continuation for high-amplitude nonlinear solutions. The curvilinear formulation preserves the fourth-order accuracy of the discretization on strongly distorted grids, and the compressible solver is confirmed to reproduce DeHNSSo-v1 in the incompressible limit. Validation spans published benchmarks for linear instability of compressible flat-plate boundary layers from $\mathrm{Ma}=0.5$ to $\mathrm{Ma}=4.5$, nonlinear oblique-mode breakdown at $\mathrm{Ma}=1.6$, nonlinear swept-wing crossflow compared with direct numerical simulations, and linear Tollmien-Schlichting wave interaction with a modeled surface-embedded Helmholtz resonator compared with experimentally validated linearized Navier-Stokes simulations. On the nonlinear test cases of DeHNSSo-v1, the computational developments result in a speed-up of approximately one order of magnitude. By broadening the scope and reducing the cost of DeHNSSo-v1, DeHNSSo-v2 provides the boundary-layer-transition and flow-control community with an accessible tool for studying receptivity, nonlinear disturbance evolution, and instability interactions with complex surface geometry and metamaterials across compressibility regimes.

AI.motivation: 原 DeHNSSo-v1 仅限不可压缩、笛卡尔/简单几何且计算成本较高，难以研究可压缩工况、复杂曲面几何及超材料与边界层不稳定性的相互作用，因此需扩展功能并降低计算开销。
